# Build N-months look-ahead data (configurable)

Note: This dataset will be by joining a) the data collected by and extracted from the augur tool (e.g., issues, prs, commits, contributors, etc.) with b) the socio-technical metrics provided in the parquet file.

The join uses a forward-looking logic: the socio-technical scores (st1, st2, st3, social supplier count, technical supplier count) for a specific month t are mapped to the augur data in month t+N, where N is set via `LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS` in the first code chunk (default: 6). Example with N=6: For month 01-01-2020 we use the socio-technical scores in this month and add the augur data from month 01-07-2020. This way, we can use the socio-technical scores to analyze their impact on future outcomes.

Update: To allow for more flexibility, the dataset now includes all non-socio-technical variables for both month t and t+N. Example: for month 01-01-2020, we have the number of issues for both month 01-01-2020 and month 01-07-2020. This allows us to build models that can control for prior outcomes as well.

**Note:** This now uses the `augur_monthly_metrics` dataset created from SQL queries of the augur database.

### Prepare ST Scores Data

First, ensure the st_scores data has proper date formatting and add a column for the target month (LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS months ahead):

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)

# Set working directory to script location
if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) && rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
  doc_path <- rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path
  if (!is.null(doc_path) && nzchar(doc_path)) {
    setwd(dirname(doc_path))
  }
}

# Repository-relative location for inputs and reproducible data artifacts.
data_dir <- file.path("..", "data")

# ============================================================
# USER CONFIGURATION: ST Scores File and Look-ahead Window
# ============================================================
# Choose which ST scores parquet file to use.
# The filename should reflect the window (e.g. WINDOW=6M, WINDOW=12M).
st_score_filename <- file.path(data_dir, "cncf_sociotechnical_scores.parquet")  # 12-month window version
# st_score_filename <- file.path(data_dir, "cncf_sociotechnical_scores_WINDOW=6M.parquet")

# Number of months to look ahead (must match the window in the parquet file).
# This controls:
#   - The target_month calculation (t + LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS)
#   - The column suffixes in the joined dataset (e.g. _t_plus_6, _t_plus_12)
#   - All downstream variable references and output filenames
LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS <- 6   # change to 3 for the 3-month window file

# Derived constants (do not edit below this line)
t_plus_n_suffix <- paste0("_t_plus_", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS)   # e.g. "_t_plus_6"

# Map ST scores filename -> ST window size (months) for output folder naming.
# Add entries here if you add new parquet files.
st_window_map <- c(
  "cncf_sociotechnical_scores.parquet"           = "12",
  "cncf_sociotechnical_scores_WINDOW=6M.parquet" = "6"
)
st_window_label <- st_window_map[basename(st_score_filename)]
if (is.na(st_window_label)) {
  # Fallback: try to extract a number from the filename
  st_window_label <- regmatches(st_score_filename, regexpr("[0-9]+", st_score_filename))
  if (length(st_window_label) == 0) st_window_label <- "unknown"
}

st_scores <- read_parquet(st_score_filename)
augur_monthly <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "augur_monthly_metrics.csv"))

cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat(sprintf("CREATING PREDICTIVE DATASET: ST SCORES ? %d-MONTH AHEAD METRICS\n", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS))
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")




projects <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "projects.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

normalize_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", " ") %>%
    stringr::str_squish()
}

projects_prepared <- projects %>%
  mutate(
    project_name_clean = normalize_name(project_name),
    accepted_date   = as.Date(accepted_date),
    sandbox_date    = as.Date(sandbox_date),
    incubating_date = as.Date(incubating_date),
    graduated_date  = as.Date(graduated_date),
    archived_date   = as.Date(archived_date)
  ) %>%
  select(
    project_name, project_name_clean,
    accepted_date, sandbox_date, incubating_date, graduated_date, archived_date
  )

augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
  mutate(
    month = as.Date(month),
    repo_name_clean = normalize_name(repo_name),
    repo_name_full = stringr::str_extract(repo_git, "[^/]+/[^/]+$"),
    repo_name_full_clean = normalize_name(repo_name_full)
  )

repo_name_uniqueness <- augur_monthly %>%
  distinct(repo_id, repo_name_clean, repo_name_full_clean) %>%
  count(repo_name_clean, name = "n_repo_name_clean")

project_name_uniqueness <- projects_prepared %>%
  count(project_name_clean, name = "n_project_name_clean")

manual_project_name_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~repo_name_full_clean, ~project_name_clean,
  "aeraki mesh aeraki", "aeraki mesh",
  "argoproj argo cd", "argo",
  "fluxcd flux2", "flux",
  "linkerd linkerd2", "linkerd",
  "open cluster management io api", "open cluster management",
  "piraeusdatastore piraeus operator", "piraeus datastore",
  "kubewarden kubewarden controller", "kubewarden",
  "strimzi strimzi kafka operator", "strimzi",
  "the update framework python tuf", "the update framework tuf",
  "networkservicemesh api", "network service mesh",
  "devfile api", "devfile",
  "metal3 io baremetal operator", "metal3 io",
  "cdk8s team cdk8s", "cdk for kubernetes cdk8s",
  "containernetworking cni", "container network interface cni",
  "knative community", "knative",
  "open feature community", "openfeature",
  "open telemetry community", "opentelemetry",
  "devspace cloud devspace cloud", "devspace",
  "dragonflyoss dragonfly", "dragonfly",
  "emissary ingress emissary", "emissary ingress",
  "foniod foniod", "fonio",
  "artifacthub hub", "artifact hub",
  "openkruise kruise", "openkruise",
  "nats io nats server", "nats",
  "networkservicemesh networkservicemesh", "network service mesh",
  "notaryproject notary", "notary project",
  "open policy agent opa", "open policy agent opa",
  "confidential containers operator", "confidential containers",
  "operator framework operator sdk", "operator framework",
  "buildpacks pack", "buildpacks",
  "piraeusdatastore piraeus", "piraeus datastore",
  # "opcr io policy", 
  "hexa org policy orchestrator",  "hexa",
  "open gitops project", "opengitops",
  "theupdateframework python tuf", "the update framework tuf",
  "slimtoolkit slim", "slimtoolkit",
  "servicemeshinterface smi spec",   "service mesh interface smi",
  "cloudevents spec", "cloudevents",
  "serverlessworkflow specification", "serverless workflow",
  "konveyor operator", "konveyor",
  "tinkerbell tink", "tinkerbell", 
  "tremor rs tremor runtime", "tremor",
  # "v6d io v6d", 
  "vscode kubernetes tools vscode kubernetes tools", "visual studio code kubernetes tools", 
  "wasmedge wasmedge", "wasmedge runtime",
  "carvel dev ytt", "carvel"
)

# # Optional manual overrides for name mismatches between project_name and repo_name
# # Add rows here only if the automatic normalized-name join misses something.
# manual_project_name_map <- tibble::tribble(
#   ~repo_name_clean, ~project_name_clean,
#   "aeraki", "aeraki mesh",
#   "argo cd", "argo",
#   "hub", "artifact hub",
#   "pack", "buildpacks",
#   "ytt", "carvel",
#   "cdk8s", "cdk for kubernetes (cdk8s)",
#   "spec", "cloudevents",
#   "operator", "confidential containers",
#   "api", "devfile",
#   "dragonfly2", "dragonfly",
#   "emissary", "emissary-ingress",
#   "flux2", "flux",
#   "policy orchestrator", "hexa",
#   "community", "knative",
#   "tackle2 operator", "konveyor",
#   "kubewarden controller", "kubewarden",
#   "baremetal operator", "metal3-io",
#   "nats server", "nats",
#   
#   # "cert manager", "cert manager",
#   # "artifacthub",  "artifact hub"
# )

augur_repo_keys <- augur_monthly %>%
  distinct(repo_id, repo_git, repo_name, repo_name_clean, repo_name_full, repo_name_full_clean) %>%
  left_join(repo_name_uniqueness, by = "repo_name_clean") %>%
  left_join(
    project_name_uniqueness %>%
      rename(repo_name_clean = project_name_clean),
    by = "repo_name_clean"
  ) %>%
  left_join(manual_project_name_map, by = "repo_name_full_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    project_name_clean_join = case_when(
      !is.na(project_name_clean) ~ project_name_clean,
      n_repo_name_clean == 1 & !is.na(n_project_name_clean) & n_project_name_clean == 1 ~ repo_name_clean,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

projects_joined <- augur_repo_keys %>%
  left_join(
    projects_prepared,
    by = c("project_name_clean_join" = "project_name_clean")
  )

cat("Project matching summary:\n")
cat("  Unique repos in Augur:", nrow(augur_repo_keys), "\n")
cat("  Matched repos:", sum(!is.na(projects_joined$project_name)), "\n")
cat("  Unmatched repos:", sum(is.na(projects_joined$project_name)), "\n\n")

unmatched_repos <- projects_joined %>%
  filter(is.na(project_name)) %>%
  select(repo_id, repo_git, repo_name, repo_name_full, repo_name_clean, repo_name_full_clean) %>%
  arrange(repo_name_clean)

if (nrow(unmatched_repos) > 0) {
  cat("Unmatched repos after automatic + manual matching:\n")
  print(head(unmatched_repos, 50))
}


augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
  left_join(
    projects_joined %>%
      select(
        repo_id, project_name,
        accepted_date, sandbox_date, incubating_date, graduated_date, archived_date
      ),
    by = "repo_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cncf_status = case_when(
      is.na(accepted_date) | month < accepted_date ~ "NotYetAccepted",
      !is.na(graduated_date) & month >= graduated_date ~ "graduated",
      !is.na(incubating_date) & month >= incubating_date ~ "incubating",
      !is.na(sandbox_date) & month >= sandbox_date ~ "sandbox",
      TRUE ~ "NotYetAccepted"
    ),
    cncf_status = factor(
      cncf_status,
      levels = c("NotYetAccepted", "sandbox", "incubating", "graduated")
    )
  )

cat("\nMonthly CNCF status distribution:\n")
print(table(augur_monthly$cncf_status, useNA = "ifany"))


# Prepare st_scores with proper date column and calculate N-month-ahead date
st_scores_prepared <- st_scores %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert period (YYYYmm format) to Date
    # Example: 202101 -> 2021-01-01
    month = as.Date(paste0(period, "01"), format = "%Y%m%d"),
    
    # Calculate the target month (LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS months ahead)
    target_month = month %m+% months(LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS),
    
    # Keep the ST score sum we created earlier
    st_sum = rowSums(select(., st1_supplier_coverage, st2_developer_coverage, st3_edge_density), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(cncf_repo_name, month, target_month, 
         st1_supplier_coverage, st2_developer_coverage, st3_edge_density, 
         technical_supplier_count, social_supplier_count, 
         social_event_count_sum_over_suppliers, social_user_count_sum_over_suppliers)

cat("Prepared ST scores:", nrow(st_scores_prepared), "rows\n")
cat("  - Date range:", format(min(st_scores_prepared$month)), "to", format(max(st_scores_prepared$month)), "\n")
cat(sprintf("  - Target range (%d months ahead):", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS), format(min(st_scores_prepared$target_month)), "to", format(max(st_scores_prepared$target_month)), "\n\n")

# Create repository name mapping
# we do this by extracting the last two pieces of repo name identifier

# Extract the last two parts of the repo_git URL to match st_scores format
# Example: "https://github.com/aeraki-mesh/aeraki" -> "aeraki-mesh/aeraki"
all_repos <- augur_monthly %>%
  mutate(
    repo_name_full = str_extract(repo_git, "[^/]+/[^/]+$")
  )

# Create a clean mapping table (one row per unique repo_name_full)
repo_mapping <- all_repos %>%
  dplyr::select(repo_git, repo_name_full, repo_id, repo_group_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(repo_name_full) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Repository mapping:\n")
cat("  - Unique repos in mapping:", n_distinct(repo_mapping$repo_name_full), "\n")
cat("  - Unique repos in st_scores:", n_distinct(st_scores_prepared$cncf_repo_name), "\n\n")

# Start building predictive dataset
# Join st_scores with repo mapping
predictive_dataset <- st_scores_prepared %>%
  left_join(repo_mapping, by = c("cncf_repo_name" = "repo_name_full"), relationship = "many-to-one")

# Report matching statistics
cat("Matching Results:\n")
cat("  - Total ST score rows:", nrow(predictive_dataset), "\n")
cat("  - Successfully matched:", sum(!is.na(predictive_dataset$repo_git)), "\n")
cat("  - Unmatched:", sum(is.na(predictive_dataset$repo_git)), "\n")

# Show unmatched repos if any
unmatched_repos <- predictive_dataset %>%
  filter(is.na(repo_git)) %>%
  distinct(cncf_repo_name) %>%
  pull(cncf_repo_name)

if (length(unmatched_repos) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Unmatched repos from st_scores:\n")
  print(head(unmatched_repos, 10))
}

# Filter to only matched rows and specified repo groups
predictive_dataset <- predictive_dataset %>%
  filter(!is.na(repo_git)) %>%
  filter(repo_group_id %in% c(100, 200, 300)) %>%
  mutate(
    repo_group_factor = factor(
      as.character(repo_group_id),
      levels = c("100", "200", "300")
    )
  )

cat("\nAfter filtering to repo groups 100, 200, 300:", nrow(predictive_dataset), "rows\n\n")

# Now merge with augur_monthly TWICE:
# 1. For month t (same month as ST scores) - suffix "_t"
# 2. For month t+LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS (look-ahead horizon) - suffix t_plus_n_suffix
cat(sprintf("Merging augur metrics for month t and month t+%d...\n", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS))

if (exists("augur_monthly") && nrow(augur_monthly) > 0) {
  # Ensure augur_monthly has date type
  augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
    mutate(month = as.Date(month))
  
  # Prepare augur data (remove duplicate repo identifiers)
  augur_clean <- augur_monthly %>%
    select(-repo_id, -repo_name, -repo_group_id)
  
  # Join 1: Augur metrics from month t (same month as ST scores)
  cat("\n1. Merging month t metrics...\n")
  augur_t <- augur_clean %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(., "_t"), -c(repo_git, month))
  
  before_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  predictive_dataset <- predictive_dataset %>%
    left_join(augur_t, 
              by = c("repo_git" = "repo_git", "month" = "month"))
  
  after_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  cat("  ? Merged month t metrics: ", before_count, "?", after_count, "rows\n")
  
  # Report matching success for month t
  metrics_matched_t <- sum(!is.na(predictive_dataset$age_in_months_t))
  cat("  ? Rows with month t metrics:", metrics_matched_t, "/", nrow(predictive_dataset), 
      "(", round(100 * metrics_matched_t / nrow(predictive_dataset), 1), "%)\n")
  
  # Join 2: Augur metrics from month t+LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS ahead
  cat(sprintf("\n2. Merging month t+%d metrics...\n", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS))
  augur_t_plus_n <- augur_clean %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(., t_plus_n_suffix), -c(repo_git, month))
  
  before_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  predictive_dataset <- predictive_dataset %>%
    left_join(augur_t_plus_n, 
              by = c("repo_git" = "repo_git", "target_month" = "month"))
  
  after_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  cat(sprintf("  ? Merged month t+%d metrics: ", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS), before_count, "?", after_count, "rows\n")
  
  # Report matching success for month t+LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS
  target_age_col <- paste0("age_in_months", t_plus_n_suffix)
  metrics_matched_t_plus_n <- sum(!is.na(predictive_dataset[[target_age_col]]))
  cat(sprintf("  ? Rows with month t+%d metrics:", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS), metrics_matched_t_plus_n, "/", nrow(predictive_dataset), 
      "(", round(100 * metrics_matched_t_plus_n / nrow(predictive_dataset), 1), "%)\n")
  
} else {
  cat("  ? ERROR: augur_monthly dataset not found!\n")
  cat("    Please run the 'Create and Save Monthly Augur Metrics Dataset' section first.\n")
}

cat("\n\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("PREDICTIVE DATASET CREATED\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

# Display the result
cat("Predictive dataset dimensions:", nrow(predictive_dataset), "rows x", ncol(predictive_dataset), "columns\n")
head(predictive_dataset, 10)
```

### Summary Statistics of the Predictive Dataset

```{r}
# Show structure
str(predictive_dataset)

# Summary statistics
cat("\n=== Dataset Overview ===\n")
cat("Number of unique repositories:", n_distinct(predictive_dataset$repo_git), "\n")
cat("Date range:", format(min(predictive_dataset$month, na.rm = TRUE)), "to", format(max(predictive_dataset$month, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Target date range (%d months ahead):", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS), format(min(predictive_dataset$target_month, na.rm = TRUE)), "to", format(max(predictive_dataset$target_month, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")

# Check for missing data
cat("\n=== Missing Data Summary ===\n")
missing_summary <- predictive_dataset %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "missing_count") %>%
  mutate(missing_pct = round(missing_count / nrow(predictive_dataset) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_count))

print(missing_summary, n = 50)
```

### Export the Predictive Dataset

```{r}
# Build output filenames that include the look-ahead window size
out_csv     <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("predictive_dataset_%dmonth_forward.csv",     LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS))
out_parquet <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("predictive_dataset_%dmonth_forward.parquet", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS))

# Save as CSV for further analysis
write.csv(predictive_dataset, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

# Also save as parquet for efficient storage
library(arrow)
write_parquet(predictive_dataset, out_parquet)

cat("Dataset saved to:\n")
cat("  -", out_csv, "\n")
cat("  -", out_parquet, "\n")

```

# Predictive Dataset Summary

```{r}
library(kableExtra)

fmt_stat <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, big.mark = ",")
}

make_stat_row <- function(group, variable, definition, x, digits = 2) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    stats <- rep("NA", 4)
  } else {
    stats <- c(
      fmt_stat(mean(x), digits),
      fmt_stat(stats::sd(x), digits),
      fmt_stat(min(x), digits),
      fmt_stat(max(x), digits)
    )
  }

  data.frame(
    Group = group,
    Variable = variable,
    Definition = definition,
    Mean = stats[1],
    SD = stats[2],
    Min = stats[3],
    Max = stats[4],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

missing_row <- function(group, variable, definition) {
  data.frame(
    Group = group,
    Variable = variable,
    Definition = definition,
    Mean = "(not available)",
    SD = "(not available)",
    Min = "(not available)",
    Max = "(not available)",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

var_row <- function(group, variable, definition, var, digits = 2) {
  if (!var %in% names(predictive_dataset)) {
    return(missing_row(group, variable, definition))
  }
  make_stat_row(group, variable, definition, predictive_dataset[[var]], digits)
}

rowmean_row <- function(group, variable, definition, vars, digits = 2) {
  if (!all(vars %in% names(predictive_dataset))) {
    return(missing_row(group, variable, definition))
  }
  x <- rowMeans(as.data.frame(predictive_dataset[vars]), na.rm = TRUE)
  make_stat_row(group, variable, definition, x, digits)
}

sum_row <- function(group, variable, definition, vars, digits = 2) {
  if (!all(vars %in% names(predictive_dataset))) {
    return(missing_row(group, variable, definition))
  }
  x <- Reduce(`+`, predictive_dataset[vars])
  make_stat_row(group, variable, definition, x, digits)
}

velocity_row <- function(group, variable, definition, digits = 2) {
  needed_vars <- paste0(c("cumulative_commits_count", "cumulative_authors",
                          "cumulative_prs_count", "cumulative_issues_count"), t_plus_n_suffix)
  if (!all(needed_vars %in% names(predictive_dataset))) {
    return(missing_row(group, variable, definition))
  }

  prs_issues <- predictive_dataset[[paste0("cumulative_prs_count", t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
    predictive_dataset[[paste0("cumulative_issues_count", t_plus_n_suffix)]]
  x <- (predictive_dataset[[paste0("cumulative_commits_count", t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
        predictive_dataset[[paste0("cumulative_authors", t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
        prs_issues) / 3
  make_stat_row(group, variable, definition, x, digits)
}

summary_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  var_row("Supply chain related variables", "ST1: Supplier Coverage", "Share of technical suppliers represented in the socio-technical network.", "st1_supplier_coverage", digits = 3),
  var_row("Supply chain related variables", "ST2: Developer Coverage", "Share of developers connected to the supplier network.", "st2_developer_coverage", digits = 3),
  var_row("Supply chain related variables", "ST3: Edge Density", "Density of ties in the socio-technical supplier-developer network.", "st3_edge_density", digits = 3),
  var_row("Supply chain related variables", "Technical Supplier Count", "Number of technical suppliers linked to the focal repository.", "technical_supplier_count", digits = 1),
  var_row("Supply chain related variables", "Social Supplier Count", "Number of social suppliers linked to the focal repository.", "social_supplier_count", digits = 1),

  rowmean_row("Dependent variables: Responsiveness", "Closure Ratios", "Average of issue and PR closure ratios at the prediction horizon.",
              paste0(c("issues_cr_closure_ratio_pct", "prs_cr_closure_ratio_pct"), t_plus_n_suffix), digits = 1),
  rowmean_row("Dependent variables: Responsiveness", "Response Time", "Average of issue and PR mean time-to-first-response at the prediction horizon.",
              paste0(c("issues_tfr_mean_hours", "prs_tfr_mean_hours"), t_plus_n_suffix), digits = 1),
  rowmean_row("Dependent variables: Responsiveness", "Closure Time", "Average of issue and PR mean time-to-close at the prediction horizon.",
              paste0(c("issues_ttc_mean_hours", "prs_ttc_mean_hours"), t_plus_n_suffix), digits = 1),
  var_row("Dependent variables: Responsiveness", paste0("Issue Response Time (t+", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS, ")"), "Average hours to first issue response at the prediction horizon.", paste0("issues_tfr_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix), digits = 1),
  var_row("Dependent variables: Responsiveness", paste0("PR Response Time (t+", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS, ")"), "Average hours to first PR response at the prediction horizon.", paste0("prs_tfr_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix), digits = 1),
  var_row("Dependent variables: Responsiveness", paste0("Issue Closure Time (t+", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS, ")"), "Average hours to close issues at the prediction horizon.", paste0("issues_ttc_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix), digits = 1),
  var_row("Dependent variables: Responsiveness", paste0("PR Closure Time (t+", LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS, ")"), "Average hours to close PRs at the prediction horizon.", paste0("prs_ttc_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix), digits = 1),

  var_row("Control variables", "Cumulative Forks", "Total forks accumulated by month t.", "cumulative_forks_t", digits = 0),

)

The sample includes `r format(n_distinct(predictive_dataset$repo_git), big.mark = ",")` unique repositories and `r format(nrow(predictive_dataset), big.mark = ",")` repo-month observations. Repositories contribute an average of `r format(round(mean(predictive_dataset %>% count(repo_git, name = "n") %>% pull(n)), 1), nsmall = 1)` months of data, with a range from `r predictive_dataset %>% count(repo_git, name = "n") %>% summarise(min_n = min(n), max_n = max(n)) %>% pull(min_n)` to `r predictive_dataset %>% count(repo_git, name = "n") %>% summarise(min_n = min(n), max_n = max(n)) %>% pull(max_n)` months.

# Build some initial prediction models

The following code builds three models: one using st1_supplier_coverage as independent variable (with various control variables), one for st2_developer_coverage, and one for st3_edge_density.

The function works by specifying a target variable (e.g., issues_tfr_mean_hours) and control variables, followed by a panel regression using repo_id and month (time) as fixed effects and vcov=twoway.

Note the terminology:

ttc = time to close

tfr = time first response

# Panel Regression Models with Fixed Effects

## Model Setup and Data Prep for Panel Analysis

```{r}
library(fixest)

# ============================================================================
# USER CONFIGURATION: Define target variable and controls
# ============================================================================

# Define predictor variables (used across all models)
predictors <- c("st1_supplier_coverage", "st2_developer_coverage", "st3_edge_density")

# Controls whether adjusted R2 is displayed in regression tables.
INCLUDE_ADJ_R2_IN_TABLES <- FALSE

# Number of decimal places for coefficient and SE values in all tables.
# Change to 3 for more compact output, 4 (default) for higher precision.
TABLE_DECIMAL_DIGITS <- 3

# ── Sub-group analysis: two distinct approaches ──────────────────────────────
#
# APPROACH 1 – Interaction terms (INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS)
#   Keeps all data in ONE pooled model and adds an interaction term:
#     i(GROUP_INTERACTION_VAR, st_var, ref = GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE)
#   Estimates HOW MUCH the ST slope differs between groups relative to the
#   reference level.  Research question: "Does the ST effect vary by group?"
#   Set INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS <- TRUE to activate.
#   GROUP_INTERACTION_VAR: "cncf_status" (default) or "repo_group_factor"
#   GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE: the baseline level (e.g. "NotYetAccepted",
#                                or "100" for repo_group_factor).
#
# APPROACH 2 – Data subset (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP, in the loop config below)
#   SUBSETS the panel to a single group value and fits a separate model on
#   that slice only.  Estimates the ST effect WITHIN that group, with no
#   cross-group comparison.  Research question: "What is the ST effect for
#   graduated projects specifically?"
#   Set LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP <- TRUE and choose LOOP_FILTER_VAR /
#   LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET in the loop configuration chunk.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS <- FALSE
# GROUP_INTERACTION_VAR <- "repo_group_factor"
# GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE <- "100"
GROUP_INTERACTION_VAR <- "cncf_status"
GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE <- "NotYetAccepted"

get_group_var_label <- function(group_var = GROUP_INTERACTION_VAR) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    group_var == "repo_group_factor" ~ "repo group",
    group_var == "cncf_status" ~ "CNCF status",
    group_var == "cncf_status_t" ~ "CNCF status",
    TRUE ~ group_var
  )
}

resolve_group_var_name <- function(data, group_var, t_suffix = "_t") {
  candidate_vars <- c(group_var, paste0(group_var, t_suffix))
  matched_var <- candidate_vars[candidate_vars %in% names(data)][1]
  
  if (is.na(matched_var)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The interaction group variable '", group_var,
        "' was not found in the data. Checked: ",
        paste(candidate_vars, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
  
  matched_var
}

get_table_gof_map <- function(include_fe = FALSE) {
  gof_map <- c("nobs", "r.squared")
  if (INCLUDE_ADJ_R2_IN_TABLES) {
    gof_map <- c(gof_map, "adj.r.squared")
  }
  if (include_fe) {
    gof_map <- c(gof_map, "FE: repo_git")
  }
  gof_map
}

format_st_result <- function(coef, se, pval, adjr2, include_adj_r2 = INCLUDE_ADJ_R2_IN_TABLES,
                             digits = TABLE_DECIMAL_DIGITS) {
  stars <- ifelse(pval < 0.01, "***",
                  ifelse(pval < 0.05, "**",
                         ifelse(pval < 0.1, "*", "")))
  fmt <- paste0("%.", digits, "f")
  if (include_adj_r2) {
    sprintf(paste0(fmt, " (", fmt, ", Adj. R2: %.3f)%s"), coef, se, adjr2, stars)
  } else {
    sprintf(paste0(fmt, " (", fmt, ")%s"), coef, se, stars)
  }
}

summary_table_note <- function() {
  effect_note <- if (INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS) {
    paste0(
      "Reported ST coefficients are baseline effects for ",
      get_group_var_label(),
      " = ",
      GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE,
      "; interaction terms in the model capture how the other levels differ from that reference."
    )
  } else {
    "Reported ST coefficients are the overall within-repository effects."
  }
  
  if (INCLUDE_ADJ_R2_IN_TABLES) {
    paste(
      "Coefficients shown with standard errors (SE) and adjusted R2 in parentheses.",
      effect_note,
      "* p<0.1, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01"
    )
  } else {
    paste(
      "Coefficients shown with standard errors (SE) in parentheses.",
      effect_note,
      "* p<0.1, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01"
    )
  }
}

get_st_main_coef_name <- function(model, st_var, use_log = TRUE, standardize = FALSE) {
  target_name <- if (standardize) paste0("zs_", st_var)
                 else if (use_log) paste0("log1p(", st_var, ")")
                 else st_var
  coef_names <- names(stats::coef(model))
  exact_match <- coef_names[coef_names == target_name]
  
  if (length(exact_match) == 1) {
    return(exact_match)
  }
  
  alt_match <- coef_names[grepl(gsub("([()])", "\\\\\\1", target_name), coef_names, fixed = FALSE) &
                            !grepl(":", coef_names, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (length(alt_match) >= 1) {
    return(alt_match[1])
  }
  
  # Return NA rather than stopping — callers check for NA and return NA_character_
  # so a single missing coefficient does not abort the whole loop iteration.
  return(NA_character_)
}

get_st_interaction_coef_name <- function(model, st_var, group_level, use_log = TRUE, standardize = FALSE) {
  target_name <- if (standardize) paste0("zs_", st_var)
                 else if (use_log) paste0("log1p(", st_var, ")")
                 else st_var
  coef_names <- names(stats::coef(model))
  matches <- coef_names[
    grepl(target_name, coef_names, fixed = TRUE) &
    grepl(as.character(group_level), coef_names, fixed = TRUE) &
    grepl(":", coef_names, fixed = TRUE)
  ]
  
  if (length(matches) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  matches[1]
}

get_coeftable_p_col <- function(coef_table) {
  p_cols <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(coef_table), value = TRUE)
  if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
    stop("Could not find a p-value column in coeftable().")
  }
  p_cols[1]
}

extract_st_effects <- function(model, st_var, use_log = TRUE,
                               include_group_interactions = FALSE,
                               group_levels = c("100", "200", "300"),
                               group_ref = GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE,
                               standardize = FALSE) {
  coef_vec <- stats::coef(model)
  vcov_mat <- stats::vcov(model)
  main_name <- get_st_main_coef_name(model, st_var, use_log = use_log, standardize = standardize)
  if (is.na(main_name)) {
    return(data.frame(Group = character(0), Estimate = numeric(0),
                      SE = numeric(0), PValue = numeric(0),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  
  if (!include_group_interactions) {
    coef_table <- fixest::coeftable(model)
    p_col <- get_coeftable_p_col(coef_table)
    main_estimate <- unname(coef_table[main_name, "Estimate"])
    main_se <- unname(coef_table[main_name, "Std. Error"])
    main_p <- unname(coef_table[main_name, p_col])
    return(data.frame(
      Group = "All Repos",
      Estimate = main_estimate,
      SE = main_se,
      PValue = main_p,
      Effect_Label = "Overall ST Effect",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  effect_rows <- lapply(group_levels, function(g) {
    if (g == group_ref) {
      estimate <- unname(coef_vec[main_name])
      variance <- unname(vcov_mat[main_name, main_name])
    } else {
      int_name <- get_st_interaction_coef_name(model, st_var, g, use_log = use_log, standardize = standardize)
      
      if (is.na(int_name)) {
        estimate <- NA_real_
        variance <- NA_real_
      } else {
        estimate <- unname(coef_vec[main_name] + coef_vec[int_name])
        variance <- unname(
          vcov_mat[main_name, main_name] +
          vcov_mat[int_name, int_name] +
          2 * vcov_mat[main_name, int_name]
        )
      }
    }
    
    data.frame(
      Group = as.character(g),
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE = sqrt(variance),
      PValue = ifelse(
        is.na(variance) || is.na(estimate),
        NA_real_,
        2 * pnorm(abs(estimate / sqrt(variance)), lower.tail = FALSE)
      ),
      Effect_Label = paste0("ST Effect (", g, ")"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  
  bind_rows(effect_rows)
}

get_reference_st_effect <- function(effects_df, group_ref = GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE) {
  target_group <- as.character(group_ref)
  
  if ("Group" %in% names(effects_df) && target_group %in% effects_df$Group) {
    return(effects_df[effects_df$Group == target_group, , drop = FALSE][1, ])
  }
  
  effects_df[1, , drop = FALSE]
}

extract_reference_st_main <- function(model, st_var, use_log = TRUE, standardize = FALSE) {
  coef_name <- get_st_main_coef_name(model, st_var, use_log = use_log, standardize = standardize)
  if (is.na(coef_name)) {
    return(data.frame(Estimate = NA_real_, SE = NA_real_, PValue = NA_real_,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  coef_table <- fixest::coeftable(model)
  p_col <- get_coeftable_p_col(coef_table)
  estimate <- unname(coef_table[coef_name, "Estimate"])
  se_val <- unname(coef_table[coef_name, "Std. Error"])
  p_val <- unname(coef_table[coef_name, p_col])
  
  data.frame(
    Estimate = estimate,
    SE = se_val,
    PValue = p_val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Helper: extract estimate/SE/p-value for any named coefficient from a feols model.
extract_named_coef <- function(model, coef_label) {
  coef_table <- fixest::coeftable(model)
  if (!coef_label %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
    return(list(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_))
  }
  p_col <- get_coeftable_p_col(coef_table)
  est  <- unname(coef_table[coef_label, "Estimate"])
  se   <- unname(coef_table[coef_label, "Std. Error"])
  pval <- unname(coef_table[coef_label, p_col])
  list(est = est, se = se, pval = pval)
}

# Helper: return the coefficient label for a control variable given the
# transformation settings (mirrors the formula construction in build_st_models).
get_control_coef_name <- function(ctrl_var, use_log = TRUE, standardize = FALSE) {
  if (standardize) paste0("zs_", ctrl_var)
  else if (use_log) paste0("log1p(", ctrl_var, ")")
  else ctrl_var
}

# TARGET VARIABLE: Choose your dependent variable
# The suffix (e.g. _t_plus_6 or _t_plus_12) is added automatically from t_plus_n_suffix.
# Base name examples: 
#   - "velocity"                       (composite score)
#   - "issues_tfr_mean_hours"          (mean time to first response on issues)
#   - "median_hours_to_close_issue"    (median time to close issues)
#   - "prs_tfr_mean_hours"             (mean PR response time)

#   - Any other numeric base column from predictive_dataset

# TARGET_VARIABLE <- paste0("velocity",                     t_plus_n_suffix)
# TARGET_VARIABLE <- paste0("median_pr_open2merge_hours",   t_plus_n_suffix)

# TARGET_VARIABLE   <- paste0("issues_ttc_mean_hours",        t_plus_n_suffix)  # CHANGE THIS
# TARGET_VARIABLE <- paste0("prs_ttc_mean_hours",           t_plus_n_suffix)
# TARGET_VARIABLE <- paste0("prs_cr_closure_ratio_pct",     t_plus_n_suffix)
TARGET_VARIABLE <- paste0("issues_tfr_mean_hours",        t_plus_n_suffix)
# TARGET_VARIABLE <- paste0("prs_tfr_mean_hours",           t_plus_n_suffix)


# CONTROL VARIABLES: Independent variables (excluding ST measures)
# NOTE: Using cumulative counts for stars, forks, and other accumulated metrics
# Using monthly/period counts for activities (PRs, issues, new contributors)
CONTROL_VARS <- c(
  "cumulative_stars_t",       # Total stars accumulated (not monthly additions)
  "cumulative_forks_t",       # Total forks accumulated (not monthly additions)
  #"num_new_contributors_t",   # New contributors this month (monthly metric)
  #"num_new_pr_contributors_t", # New PR contributors this month (monthly metric)
  #"num_prs_opened_t",          # PRs opened this month (monthly metric)
  #"num_prs_closed_t",          # PRs closed this month (monthly metric)
  #"num_issues_opened_t",       # Issues opened this month (monthly metric)
  #"num_issues_closed_t",       # Issues closed this month (monthly metric)
  #"cumulative_commits_t",     # Total commits accumulated
  #"cumulative_authors_t",     # Total unique authors accumulated
  #"cumulative_releases_t",
  #"num_contributions_t",      # Contributions this period (monthly metric)
  "age_in_months_t",           # Repository age
  "technical_supplier_count",
  "social_supplier_count"
)

# ── Open issues / PRs control ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# When TRUE, the count of still-open issues and PRs at time t is added as a
# control variable in all models.  A large backlog of open items can affect
# many outcomes beyond just responsiveness (e.g. contributor load, bus factor),
# so including it universally gives a cleaner estimate of the ST score effects.
ADD_OPEN_ISSUES_CONTROL <- TRUE
OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL <- "issues_cr_still_open_t"   # open issue count at time t
OPEN_PRS_CTRL    <- "prs_cr_still_open_t"       # open PR count at time t

# Auto-add open issues/PRs control for the standalone-model target variable
if (ADD_OPEN_ISSUES_CONTROL) {
  if (OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL %in% names(predictive_dataset)) {
    CONTROL_VARS <- unique(c(CONTROL_VARS, OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL))
  }
  if (OPEN_PRS_CTRL %in% names(predictive_dataset)) {
    CONTROL_VARS <- unique(c(CONTROL_VARS, OPEN_PRS_CTRL))
  }
}

        "(", round(100 * sum(!is.na(panel_data[[var]])) / nrow(panel_data), 1), "%)\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ", var, ": MISSING FROM DATASET\n")
  }
}


cat("Replaced NAs with 0 for monthly activity metrics\n")

cat("\nControl variable availability (AFTER NA->0 replacement):\n")
for (var in CONTROL_VARS) {
  if (var %in% names(panel_data)) {
    cat("  ", var, ":", sum(!is.na(panel_data[[var]])), "/", nrow(panel_data), 
        "(", round(100 * sum(!is.na(panel_data[[var]])) / nrow(panel_data), 1), "%)\n")
  }
}

## Function to Build All Three ST Models

```{r}

use_log <- TRUE

# Set TRUE to z-score-standardise all variables (after log1p if use_log = TRUE).
# Produces beta coefficients on the same scale across all predictors, making it
# easy to compare ST scores (0-1) with supplier counts (tens/hundreds).
STANDARDIZE_VARS <- FALSE

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Residualized ST scores
# Removes variance in ST scores explained by the same controls
# used in the main models, except the open issue/PR backlog controls.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

residual_excluded_controls <- c(OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL, OPEN_PRS_CTRL)
residual_controls <- setdiff(CONTROL_VARS, residual_excluded_controls)

residualize_st_score <- function(data, st_var, residual_controls,
                                 entity_var = "repo_id",
                                 time_var   = "month",
                                 use_log    = TRUE) {
  # FWL-consistent residualization: regress the ST score on controls using
  # the same two-way fixed effects (entity + time) as the main panel models.
  # The residuals therefore capture only the within-entity, within-time
  # variation in the ST score that is orthogonal to the structural controls,
  # so that robustness checks based on them are fully consistent with the
  # FWL (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell) theorem.
  
  required_vars <- c(st_var, entity_var, time_var, residual_controls)
  missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(data))
  
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing variables for residualization: ",
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  data_with_id <- data %>%
    mutate(.row_id_resid = row_number())
  
  # Pre-apply log1p to the ST variable and controls *before* building resid_df.
  # If we leave log1p() inside the feols formula, feols silently drops rows
  # where the formula-evaluated value is NaN/Inf but does NOT record those in
  # obs_selection$obsRemoved (which only tracks singleton removals). This
  # causes a length mismatch between obs_kept and residuals(), producing
  # recycled/garbage residuals that can have near-zero within-group variance,
  # which feols then drops as collinear — cascading into downstream errors.
  if (use_log) {
    lhs_col  <- paste0(".lhs.", st_var)
    rhs_cols <- if (length(residual_controls) > 0L)
      paste0(".rhs.", residual_controls) else character(0)
    data_with_id <- data_with_id %>%
      mutate(
        !!lhs_col := log1p(!!sym(st_var)),
        across(all_of(residual_controls), ~ log1p(.x), .names = ".rhs.{.col}")
      )
    lhs         <- lhs_col
    rhs         <- if (length(rhs_cols) > 0L) paste(rhs_cols, collapse = " + ") else "1"
    finite_cols <- c(lhs_col, rhs_cols)
  } else {
    lhs         <- st_var
    rhs         <- if (length(residual_controls) > 0L) paste(residual_controls, collapse = " + ") else "1"
    finite_cols <- c(st_var, residual_controls)
  }
  
  cols_to_keep <- unique(c(".row_id_resid", entity_var, time_var, finite_cols))
  resid_df <- data_with_id %>%
    select(all_of(cols_to_keep)) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(finite_cols), is.finite))
  
  if (nrow(resid_df) < 10L) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))
  }
  
  resid_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(lhs, " ~ ", rhs, " | ", entity_var, " + ", time_var)
  )
  
  # Try feols with two-way clustered SEs (matches main models for consistency).
  # vcov choice does not affect residuals, only SEs — but twoway can throw hard
  # errors on small/sparse subsets (too few clusters). We cascade through
  # progressively simpler SE estimators and fall back to lm() if needed.
  resid_model <- tryCatch(
    feols(resid_formula, data = resid_df, vcov = "twoway", fixef.rm = "none"),
    error = function(e1) {
      tryCatch(
        feols(resid_formula, data = resid_df, vcov = "iid", fixef.rm = "none"),
        error = function(e2) {
          # lm() fallback: no FE, pooled OLS — less rigorous but keeps loop alive
          warning(
            "feols() failed in residualize_st_score for '", st_var, "'; ",
            "falling back to pooled OLS (residuals are not FWL-consistent).\n",
            "feols error: ", conditionMessage(e1)
          )
          ols_formula <- as.formula(paste0(lhs, " ~ ", if (nzchar(rhs)) rhs else "1"))
          lm(ols_formula, data = resid_df)
        }
      )
    }
  )
  
  # Map residuals back to the original data rows.
  out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))
  if (inherits(resid_model, "fixest")) {
    resid_values <- residuals(resid_model)
    
    if (length(resid_values) == nrow(resid_df)) {
      obs_kept <- seq_len(nrow(resid_df))
    } else {
      obs_removed <- sort(unique(abs(unlist(resid_model$obs_selection))))
      obs_kept <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(resid_df)), obs_removed)
    }
    
    out[resid_df$.row_id_resid[obs_kept]] <- resid_values
  } else {
    # lm fallback: all rows in resid_df get a residual
    out[resid_df$.row_id_resid] <- residuals(resid_model)
  }
  
  return(out)
}

panel_complete <- panel_complete %>%
  mutate(
    st1_resid = residualize_st_score(
      data = panel_complete,
      st_var = "st1_supplier_coverage",
      residual_controls = residual_controls
    ),
    st2_resid = residualize_st_score(
      data = panel_complete,
      st_var = "st2_developer_coverage",
      residual_controls = residual_controls
    ),
    st3_resid = residualize_st_score(
      data = panel_complete,
      st_var = "st3_edge_density",
      residual_controls = residual_controls
    )
  )

cat("\nResidualized ST variables created:\n")
print(summary(panel_complete %>% select(st1_resid, st2_resid, st3_resid)))

# Function to build and summarize all three ST models at once
build_st_models <- function(data, target_var, control_vars, 
                            vcov_type = "twoway", 
                            fixed_effects = "repo_id + month",
                            use_log = TRUE,
                            standardize = FALSE,
                            include_group_interactions = FALSE,
                            group_var = GROUP_INTERACTION_VAR,
                            group_ref = GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE,
                            st_var_keys = c("ST1", "ST2", "ST3")) {
  
  # Define ST variables
  # all_st_vars <- list(
  #   ST1 = "st1_supplier_coverage",
  #   ST2 = "st2_developer_coverage",
  #   ST3 = "st3_edge_density"
  # )
  all_st_vars <- list(
    ST1 = "st1_supplier_coverage",
    ST2 = "st2_developer_coverage",
    ST3 = "st3_edge_density",
    ST1_resid = "st1_resid",
    ST2_resid = "st2_resid",
    ST3_resid = "st3_resid"
  )
  st_vars <- all_st_vars[intersect(st_var_keys, names(all_st_vars))]
  if (length(st_vars) == 0) {
    stop("No valid ST variables selected. Use one or more of: ST1, ST2, ST3.")
  }
  
  # Initialize results list
  models <- list()
  model_data <- list()
  group_var_in_data <- if (include_group_interactions) {
    resolve_group_var_name(data, group_var)
  } else {
    group_var
  }
  
  cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("BUILDING PANEL REGRESSION MODELS\n")
  cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  cat("Target Variable:", target_var, "\n")
  cat("Control Variables:", paste(control_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Fixed Effects:", fixed_effects, "\n")
  cat("VCOV Type:", vcov_type, "\n")
  cat("Log Transformation:", use_log, "\n")
  cat("Standardize Variables:", standardize, "\n")
  cat("Group Interactions:", include_group_interactions, "\n")
  if (include_group_interactions) {
    cat("Interaction Group Variable:", group_var_in_data, "\n")
    cat("Reference Level:", group_ref, "\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Controls that do not vary within the entity fixed effect are not identified
  # in a within-repository model, so we drop them up front with an explicit note.
  entity_fe <- trimws(strsplit(fixed_effects, "\\+")[[1]][1])
  usable_controls <- control_vars
  
  if (entity_fe %in% names(data)) {
    invariant_controls <- c()
    
    for (ctrl in control_vars) {
      if (ctrl %in% names(data)) {
        variation_check <- data %>%
          group_by(.data[[entity_fe]]) %>%
          summarise(n_vals = n_distinct(.data[[ctrl]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
        
        if (all(variation_check$n_vals <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
          invariant_controls <- c(invariant_controls, ctrl)
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (length(invariant_controls) > 0) {
      cat("Dropping controls collinear with", entity_fe, "fixed effects:\n")
      cat("  ", paste(invariant_controls, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
      usable_controls <- setdiff(control_vars, invariant_controls)
    }
  }
  
  model_comparison_rows <- list()
  
  # Build each model
  for (st_name in names(st_vars)) {
    st_var <- st_vars[[st_name]]
    
    cat("Building Model", st_name, "...\n")
    
    # Filter data for this ST variable
    model_df <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(st_var)))
    
    
    # Create formula with log transformation and/or standardization
    if (standardize) {
      
      # Standardize all variables: z-score of log1p(x) if use_log, else z-score of x.
      all_model_vars <- unique(c(target_var, st_var, usable_controls))
      
      for (v in all_model_vars) {
        if (v %in% names(model_df) && is.numeric(model_df[[v]])) {
          raw_vals <- if (use_log && !str_detect(v, "_resid$")) {
            log1p(model_df[[v]])
          } else {
            model_df[[v]]
          }
          model_df[[paste0("zs_", v)]] <- as.numeric(scale(raw_vals))
        }
      }
      
      target_formula <- paste0("zs_", target_var)
      st_formula <- paste0("zs_", st_var)
      
      controls_formula <- if (length(usable_controls) > 0) {
        paste(paste0("zs_", usable_controls), collapse = " + ")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      interaction_formula <- if (include_group_interactions) {
        paste0("i(", group_var_in_data, ", ", st_formula, ", ref = '", group_ref, "')")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      rhs_terms <- c(st_formula, interaction_formula, controls_formula)
      rhs_terms <- rhs_terms[nzchar(rhs_terms)]
      
      formula_str <- paste0(
        target_formula,
        " ~ ",
        paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + "),
        " | ",
        fixed_effects
      )
      
    } else if (use_log) {
      
      # Log-transform dependent variable and controls.
      # Do not log residualized ST variables because residuals can be negative.
      target_formula <- paste0("log1p(", target_var, ")")
      
      st_formula <- if (str_detect(st_var, "_resid$")) {
        st_var
      } else {
        paste0("log1p(", st_var, ")")
      }
      
      controls_formula <- if (length(usable_controls) > 0) {
        paste(sapply(usable_controls, function(x) paste0("log1p(", x, ")")), collapse = " + ")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      interaction_formula <- if (include_group_interactions) {
        paste0("i(", group_var_in_data, ", ", st_formula, ", ref = '", group_ref, "')")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      rhs_terms <- c(st_formula, interaction_formula, controls_formula)
      rhs_terms <- rhs_terms[nzchar(rhs_terms)]
      
      formula_str <- paste0(
        target_formula,
        " ~ ",
        paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + "),
        " | ",
        fixed_effects
      )
      
    } else {
      
      # No transformation
      target_formula <- target_var
      st_formula <- st_var
      
      controls_formula <- if (length(usable_controls) > 0) {
        paste(usable_controls, collapse = " + ")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      interaction_formula <- if (include_group_interactions) {
        paste0("i(", group_var_in_data, ", ", st_formula, ", ref = '", group_ref, "')")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      rhs_terms <- c(st_formula, interaction_formula, controls_formula)
      rhs_terms <- rhs_terms[nzchar(rhs_terms)]
      
      formula_str <- paste0(
        target_formula,
        " ~ ",
        paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + "),
        " | ",
        fixed_effects
      )
    }
    # Estimate model — cascade from twoway → iid so sparse-cluster subsets
    # (e.g. targets with many NA rows) don't abort the whole loop iteration.
    model <- tryCatch(
      feols(as.formula(formula_str), data = model_df, vcov = vcov_type),
      error = function(e1) {
        if (identical(vcov_type, "twoway")) {
          warning("feols(vcov='twoway') failed for ", st_name, "/", target_var,
                  "; retrying with vcov='iid'. Error: ", conditionMessage(e1))
          tryCatch(
            feols(as.formula(formula_str), data = model_df, vcov = "iid"),
            error = function(e2) stop(conditionMessage(e2))
          )
        } else {
          stop(conditionMessage(e1))
        }
      }
    )
    
    # Store results
    models[[st_name]] <- model
    model_data[[st_name]] <- model_df
    
    # Build null model on the SAME sample as the ST model
    null_rhs_i <- if (length(usable_controls) > 0) {
      controls_formula
    } else {
      "1"
    }
    
    null_formula_str_i <- paste0(
      target_formula, " ~ ", null_rhs_i, " | ", fixed_effects
    )
    
    null_model_i <- feols(
      as.formula(null_formula_str_i),
      data = model_df,
      vcov = vcov_type
    )
    
    # Safety check BEFORE using model inside tibble()
    if (!inherits(model, "fixest")) {
      stop(
        "The object returned by feols() is not a fixest model. Class is: ",
        paste(class(model), collapse = ", "),
        "\nFormula was: ", formula_str
      )
    }
    
    # Extract fit statistics before tibble() to avoid name conflicts
    n_obs_i <- nobs(model)
    
    wr2_null_i <- unname(fixest::r2(null_model_i, type = "wr2"))
    wr2_st_i   <- unname(fixest::r2(model, type = "wr2"))
    
    ar2_null_i <- unname(fixest::r2(null_model_i, type = "ar2"))
    ar2_st_i   <- unname(fixest::r2(model, type = "ar2"))
    
    aic_null_i <- AIC(null_model_i)
    aic_st_i   <- AIC(model)
    
    bic_null_i <- BIC(null_model_i)
    bic_st_i   <- BIC(model)
    
    # Store model comparison
    model_comparison_rows[[st_name]] <- tibble(
      model_name = st_name,
      n_obs = n_obs_i,
      n_repo = n_distinct(model_df$repo_id),
      n_month = n_distinct(model_df$target_month),
    
      wr2_null = wr2_null_i,
      wr2_st = wr2_st_i,
      delta_wr2 = wr2_st_i - wr2_null_i,
    
      ar2_null = ar2_null_i,
      ar2_st = ar2_st_i,
      delta_ar2 = ar2_st_i - ar2_null_i,
    
      aic_null = aic_null_i,
      aic_st = aic_st_i,
      delta_aic = aic_st_i - aic_null_i,
    
      bic_null = bic_null_i,
      bic_st = bic_st_i,
      delta_bic = bic_st_i - bic_null_i
    )
  }
  
  cat("  - Observations:", n_obs_i, "\n")
  cat("  - Repositories:", n_distinct(model_df$repo_id), "\n")
  cat("  - Months:", n_distinct(model_df$target_month), "\n")
  cat("  - R² (within):", round(wr2_st_i, 4), "\n\n")
  
  # Build null model (controls only, no ST variables — useful as a baseline)
  cat("Building Null model (no ST variables, controls only)...\n")
  
  null_df <- data
  
  if (standardize) {
    
    all_null_vars <- unique(c(target_var, usable_controls))
    
    for (v in all_null_vars) {
      if (v %in% names(null_df) && is.numeric(null_df[[v]])) {
        raw_vals <- if (use_log && !str_detect(v, "_resid$")) {
          log1p(null_df[[v]])
        } else {
          null_df[[v]]
        }
        null_df[[paste0("zs_", v)]] <- as.numeric(scale(raw_vals))
      }
    }
    
    null_target <- paste0("zs_", target_var)
    
    null_controls <- if (length(usable_controls) > 0) {
      paste(paste0("zs_", usable_controls), collapse = " + ")
    } else {
      "1"
    }
    
    null_formula_str <- paste0(
      null_target,
      " ~ ",
      null_controls,
      " | ",
      fixed_effects
    )
    
  } else if (use_log) {
    
    null_target <- paste0("log1p(", target_var, ")")
    
    null_controls <- if (length(usable_controls) > 0) {
      paste(sapply(usable_controls, function(x) paste0("log1p(", x, ")")), collapse = " + ")
    } else {
      "1"
    }
    
    null_formula_str <- paste0(
      null_target,
      " ~ ",
      null_controls,
      " | ",
      fixed_effects
    )
    
  } else {
    
    null_target <- target_var
    
    null_controls <- if (length(usable_controls) > 0) {
      paste(usable_controls, collapse = " + ")
    } else {
      "1"
    }
    
    null_formula_str <- paste0(
      null_target,
      " ~ ",
      null_controls,
      " | ",
      fixed_effects
    )
  }
  
  null_model <- tryCatch(
    feols(as.formula(null_formula_str), data = null_df, vcov = vcov_type),
    error = function(e1) {
      if (identical(vcov_type, "twoway")) {
        warning("feols(vcov='twoway') failed for Null model/", target_var,
                "; retrying with vcov='iid'. Error: ", conditionMessage(e1))
        tryCatch(
          feols(as.formula(null_formula_str), data = null_df, vcov = "iid"),
          error = function(e2) stop(conditionMessage(e2))
        )
      } else {
        stop(conditionMessage(e1))
      }
    }
  )
  
  models[["Null"]]     <- null_model
  model_data[["Null"]] <- null_df
  
  cat("  - Observations:", nobs(null_model), "\n")
  cat("  - Repositories:", n_distinct(null_df$repo_id), "\n")
  cat("  - R² (within):", round(r2(null_model, type = "wr2"), 4), "\n\n")
  
  
  cat("All models built successfully!\n\n")
  
  # Return results
  return(list(
    models = models,
    data = model_data,
    model_comparison = bind_rows(model_comparison_rows),
    target_var = target_var,
    control_vars = usable_controls,
    st_vars = st_vars,
    include_group_interactions = include_group_interactions,
    group_var = group_var_in_data,
    group_ref = group_ref,
    standardize = standardize
  ))
}

# Build all three models

)

model1_resid_fe <- results_resid$models$ST1_resid
model2_resid_fe <- results_resid$models$ST2_resid
model3_resid_fe <- results_resid$models$ST3_resid

model_comparison_resid <- results_resid$model_comparison

st_resid_diagnostics <- tibble(
  st_score = c("ST1", "ST2", "ST3"),
  r2_explained_by_controls = c(
    summary(lm(log1p(st1_supplier_coverage) ~ 
                 log1p(cumulative_stars_t) +
                 log1p(cumulative_forks_t) +
                 log1p(age_in_months_t) +
                 log1p(technical_supplier_count) +
                 log1p(social_supplier_count),
               data = panel_complete))$r.squared,
    
    summary(lm(log1p(st2_developer_coverage) ~ 
                 log1p(cumulative_stars_t) +
                 log1p(cumulative_forks_t) +
                 log1p(age_in_months_t) +
                 log1p(technical_supplier_count) +
                 log1p(social_supplier_count),
               data = panel_complete))$r.squared,
    
    summary(lm(log1p(st3_edge_density) ~ 
                 log1p(cumulative_stars_t) +
                 log1p(cumulative_forks_t) +
                 log1p(age_in_months_t) +
                 log1p(technical_supplier_count) +
                 log1p(social_supplier_count),
               data = panel_complete))$r.squared
  )
)

print(st_resid_diagnostics)

```{r}
library(modelsummary)

# Create list of models (null baseline + ST models)
models_list <- list(
  "Null: Controls Only" = null_model,
  "ST1: Supplier Coverage" = model1_fe,
  "ST2: Developer Coverage" = model2_fe,
  "ST3: Edge Density" = model3_fe
)

# Create publication-ready table with robust standard errors
# fixest models already have robust SEs specified, so we use those
cat("\n\n=== PANEL REGRESSION RESULTS TABLE ===\n\n")

target_var_text <- ifelse(use_log, paste0("log1p(", TARGET_VARIABLE, ")"), TARGET_VARIABLE)
interaction_note <- if (INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS) {
  paste0(
    "ST interactions included with ",

} else {

}

modelsummary(
  models_list,

cat("\n\n=== MODEL DIAGNOSTICS COMPARISON ===\n\n")

# Extract ST effects from fixest models
model1_effects <- extract_st_effects(
  model1_fe, "st1_supplier_coverage", use_log = use_log,
  include_group_interactions = INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS,

)
model2_effects <- extract_st_effects(

)
model3_effects <- extract_st_effects(

  standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS
)

model1_base <- extract_reference_st_main(model1_fe, "st1_supplier_coverage", use_log = use_log, standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS)
model2_base <- extract_reference_st_main(model2_fe, "st2_developer_coverage", use_log = use_log, standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS)
model3_base <- extract_reference_st_main(model3_fe, "st3_edge_density", use_log = use_log, standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS)

model1_coef <- model1_base$Estimate

model2_coef <- model2_base$Estimate

diagnostics_df <- data.frame(

  ),

    round(r2(model3_fe, type = "wr2"), 4),
    round(r2(model3_fe, type = "ar2"), 4),
    round(model3_coef, 4),
    round(model3_se, 4),
    format.pval(model3_pval, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    ifelse(model3_pval < 0.1, "YES *", "NO")
  )
)

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  kable(diagnostics_df,
        col.names = c("Metric", "Model 1: ST1", "Model 2: ST2", "Model 3: ST3"),
        caption = paste("Diagnostic Statistics Comparison -", TARGET_VARIABLE, "as Dependent Variable"),
        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"),
        format = "html") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),

    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
    row_spec(c(6, 7, 8, 9), background = "#ffffcc") %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Fixed Effects Panel Regression Models" = 3)) %>%
    kableExtra::footnote(general = summary_table_note(),
             general_title = "Note:",

} else {
  kable(diagnostics_df,
        col.names = c("Metric", "Model 1: ST1", "Model 2: ST2", "Model 3: ST3"),

        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"))
}

# Create coefficient plot for ST variables
cat("\n\n=== COEFFICIENT PLOT: ST METRICS IMPACT ===\n\n")

library(ggplot2)

st_coefs <- bind_rows(
  model1_effects %>% mutate(Model = "ST1:\nSupplier Coverage"),
  model2_effects %>% mutate(Model = "ST2:\nDeveloper Coverage"),
  model3_effects %>% mutate(Model = "ST3:\nEdge Density")
)

st_coefs <- st_coefs %>%
  mutate(
    CI_lower = Estimate - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_upper = Estimate + 1.96 * SE,
    Significant = ifelse(PValue < 0.1, "Yes", "No")
  )

ggplot(st_coefs, aes(x = Model, y = Estimate, color = Significant, shape = Group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), width = 0.2, size = 1,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No" = "gray60", "Yes" = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Impact of Socio-Technical Metrics on", TARGET_VARIABLE),

    y = "Coefficient Estimate (Robust SE)",
    color = "Significant\n(p < 0.1)",
    shape = get_group_var_label()
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  coord_flip()
