# Loop Through Multiple Target Variables

This section runs the panel regression models for multiple target variables and saves the results (modelsummary table and coefficient plot) to the "Sample Models" subdirectory.

```{r}
# Output directory encodes both the ST scores window and the look-ahead horizon,
# e.g. "Results_ST_Window_6_Lookahead_6" or "Results_ST_Window_12_Lookahead_12".
output_dir <- sprintf("Results_ST_Window_%s_Lookahead_%d", st_window_label, LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS)

# ── Loop controls (Approach 2: data-subset sub-group analysis) ───────────────
# Set LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP <- TRUE to restrict every model in the loop to a
# single group value.  Choose the grouping variable and the target level:
#   LOOP_FILTER_VAR  : "cncf_status"      → filter on CNCF maturity stage
#                      "repo_group_factor" → filter on repo group (100/200/300)
#   LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET: the exact value to keep (e.g. "graduated", "100")
LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP <- FALSE
LOOP_FILTER_VAR      <- "cncf_status"   # "cncf_status" or "repo_group_factor"
LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET    <- "graduated"
LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3 <- FALSE

if (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP) {
  subset_stub <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET)
  var_stub    <- switch(LOOP_FILTER_VAR,
    "cncf_status"      = "CNCFStatus",
    "repo_group_factor" = "RepoGroup",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", LOOP_FILTER_VAR)
  )
  output_dir <- paste0(output_dir, "_", var_stub, "_", subset_stub)
}
if (!LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) {
  output_dir <- paste0(output_dir, "_NoST3")
}

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  cat("Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# Derived targets for the updated concept structure.
# Use base-R column indexing so that t_plus_n_suffix is evaluated at runtime.
prs_iss_loop_col            <- paste0("prs_issues_combined", t_plus_n_suffix)
vel_loop_col                <- paste0("velocity", t_plus_n_suffix)
resp_closure_ratio_loop_col <- "responsiveness_closure_ratio"
resp_response_time_loop_col <- "responsiveness_response_time"
resp_closure_time_loop_col  <- "responsiveness_closure_time"

panel_data[[prs_iss_loop_col]] <-
  panel_data[[paste0("cumulative_prs_count",   t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
  panel_data[[paste0("cumulative_issues_count", t_plus_n_suffix)]]

panel_data[[vel_loop_col]] <-
  (panel_data[[paste0("cumulative_commits_count", t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
   panel_data[[paste0("cumulative_authors",        t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
   panel_data[[prs_iss_loop_col]]) / 3

# Composite responsiveness outcomes use the available issue/PR component when
# the other component is missing; rows with both components missing become NaN
# and are removed by the target complete-case filter below.
panel_data[[resp_closure_ratio_loop_col]] <- rowMeans(
  cbind(
    panel_data[[paste0("issues_cr_closure_ratio_pct", t_plus_n_suffix)]],
    panel_data[[paste0("prs_cr_closure_ratio_pct", t_plus_n_suffix)]]
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

panel_data[[resp_response_time_loop_col]] <- rowMeans(
  cbind(
    panel_data[[paste0("issues_tfr_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix)]],
    panel_data[[paste0("prs_tfr_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix)]]
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

panel_data[[resp_closure_time_loop_col]] <- rowMeans(
  cbind(
    panel_data[[paste0("issues_ttc_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix)]],
    panel_data[[paste0("prs_ttc_mean_hours", t_plus_n_suffix)]]
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

USE_INDIVIDUAL_BUS_FACTORS <- TRUE

if (USE_INDIVIDUAL_BUS_FACTORS) {
  community_targets <- paste0(c("num_commits", "num_contributors", "num_core_contributors", "num_new_contributors",
                                "bus_factor_comments", "bus_factor_commits", "bus_factor_issues"), t_plus_n_suffix)
  community_labels <- c("Monthly Commits", "Contributors", "Core Contributors", "New Contributors",
                        "Comments Bus Factor", "Commits Bus Factor", "Issues Bus Factor")
  community_control_vars <- c("num_commits_t", "num_contributors_t", "num_core_contributors_t", "num_new_contributors_t",
                              "bus_factor_comments_t", "bus_factor_commits_t", "bus_factor_issues_t")
} else {
  community_targets <- paste0(c("num_commits", "num_contributors", "num_core_contributors", "num_new_contributors",
                                "bus_factor"), t_plus_n_suffix)
  community_labels <- c("Monthly Commits", "Contributors", "Core Contributors", "New Contributors", "Overall Bus Factor")
  community_control_vars <- c("num_commits_t", "num_contributors_t", "num_core_contributors_t", "num_new_contributors_t",
                              "bus_factor_t")
}

target_variables_to_test <- c(
  resp_closure_ratio_loop_col,
  resp_response_time_loop_col,
  resp_closure_time_loop_col,
  paste0(c("issues_tfr_mean_hours", "prs_tfr_mean_hours", "issues_ttc_mean_hours", "prs_ttc_mean_hours"), t_plus_n_suffix),
  community_targets,
  paste0(c("cumulative_authors", "cumulative_commits_count", "prs_issues_combined", "velocity"), t_plus_n_suffix)
)

loop_st_var_keys <- if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) c("ST1", "ST2", "ST3") else c("ST1", "ST2")
loop_status_var <- if (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP) {
  resolve_group_var_name(panel_data, LOOP_FILTER_VAR)
} else {
  resolve_group_var_name(panel_data, "cncf_status")
}

st_model_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~key,  ~table_label,                 ~plot_label,                  ~st_var,                    ~result_key,
  "ST1", "ST1: Supplier Coverage",     "ST1:\nSupplier Coverage",    "st1_supplier_coverage",    "st1",
  "ST2", "ST2: Developer Coverage",    "ST2:\nDeveloper Coverage",   "st2_developer_coverage",   "st2",
  "ST3", "ST3: Edge Density",          "ST3:\nEdge Density",         "st3_edge_density",         "st3"
)
loop_specs <- st_model_specs %>% filter(key %in% loop_st_var_keys)

# Control variables (base set for all models)
control_vars_base <- c(
  "cumulative_stars_t",
  "cumulative_forks_t",
  "age_in_months_t",
  "technical_supplier_count",
  "social_supplier_count"
)

concept_map_targets <- c(
  setNames(rep("Responsiveness", 7),
           c(resp_closure_ratio_loop_col,
             resp_response_time_loop_col,
             resp_closure_time_loop_col,
             paste0(c("issues_tfr_mean_hours", "prs_tfr_mean_hours", "issues_ttc_mean_hours", "prs_ttc_mean_hours"), t_plus_n_suffix))),
  setNames(rep("Community", length(community_targets)), community_targets),
  setNames(rep("Growth", 4),
           paste0(c("cumulative_authors", "cumulative_commits_count", "prs_issues_combined", "velocity"), t_plus_n_suffix))
)

target_display_labels <- c(
  setNames(c("Closure Ratios", "Avg Response Time", "Avg Closure Time", "Issue Response Time", "PR Response Time", "Issue Closure Time", "PR Closure Time"),
           c(resp_closure_ratio_loop_col,
             resp_response_time_loop_col,
             resp_closure_time_loop_col,
             paste0(c("issues_tfr_mean_hours", "prs_tfr_mean_hours", "issues_ttc_mean_hours", "prs_ttc_mean_hours"), t_plus_n_suffix))),
  setNames(community_labels, community_targets),
  setNames(c("Cumulative Authors", "Cumulative Commits", "PRs + Issues Combined", "Velocity"),
           paste0(c("cumulative_authors", "cumulative_commits_count", "prs_issues_combined", "velocity"), t_plus_n_suffix))
)

cat("\n\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("RUNNING MODELS FOR MULTIPLE TARGET VARIABLES\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")
cat("Target variables:", length(target_variables_to_test), "\n")
cat("Output directory:", output_dir, "\n\n")

# Initialize results collection
results_summary <- list()

# Loop through each target variable
for (target_var in target_variables_to_test) {
  
  target_var_text <- unname(target_display_labels[target_var])
  if (is.na(target_var_text) || target_var_text == "") {
    target_var_text <- gsub("_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_var))
  }
  target_var_file_stub <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_var))
  
  # Select controls based on concept to avoid controlling away outcomes
  concept_for_target <- concept_map_targets[target_var]
  control_vars_loop <- control_vars_base
  if (!is.na(concept_for_target) && concept_for_target == "Community") {
    control_vars_loop <- setdiff(control_vars_loop, community_control_vars)
  }
  if (!is.na(concept_for_target) && concept_for_target == "Growth") {
    control_vars_loop <- setdiff(control_vars_loop, c("cumulative_commits_count_t", "cumulative_authors_t", "cumulative_prs_count_t", "cumulative_issues_count_t", "num_commits_t"))
  }
  # Add open issues/PRs count at t as a control for all models
  if (ADD_OPEN_ISSUES_CONTROL) {
    if (OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL %in% names(panel_data)) {
      control_vars_loop <- unique(c(control_vars_loop, OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL))
    }
    if (OPEN_PRS_CTRL %in% names(panel_data)) {
      control_vars_loop <- unique(c(control_vars_loop, OPEN_PRS_CTRL))
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n", "=" %>% rep(60) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("Processing:", target_var_text, "\n")
  cat("=" %>% rep(60) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  # Check if variable exists
  if (!target_var %in% names(panel_data)) {
    cat("  âœ— Variable not found in dataset - SKIPPING\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Filter complete cases for this target variable
  panel_complete_loop <- panel_data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(!!sym(target_var)),
      (!is.na(st1_supplier_coverage) | !is.na(st2_developer_coverage) | !is.na(st3_edge_density))
    )
  
  # Match the standalone model window so the batch summary is comparable.
  panel_complete_loop <- panel_complete_loop %>%
    filter(target_month <= as.Date("2026-01-01"))

  # Keep a target-specific base sample before applying controls. Main models
  # and residualized robustness models use different control sets, so their
  # complete-case filters are applied separately below.
  panel_complete_loop_base <- panel_complete_loop
  
  # Filter for control variables
  for (var in control_vars_loop) {
    if (var %in% names(panel_complete_loop)) {
      panel_complete_loop <- panel_complete_loop %>%
        filter(!is.na(!!sym(var)))
    }
  }
  
  if (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP) {
    panel_complete_loop <- panel_complete_loop %>%
      filter(.data[[loop_status_var]] == LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET)
  }
  
  cat("  Complete cases:", nrow(panel_complete_loop), "\n")
  
  # Skip if insufficient data
  if (nrow(panel_complete_loop) < 100) {
    cat("  âœ— Insufficient data - SKIPPING\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Build models
  tryCatch({
    results_loop <- build_st_models(
      data = panel_complete_loop,
      target_var = target_var,
      control_vars = control_vars_loop,
      vcov_type = "twoway",
      fixed_effects = "repo_id + month",
      use_log = use_log,
      standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS,
      include_group_interactions = INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS,
      group_var = GROUP_INTERACTION_VAR,
      group_ref = GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE,
      st_var_keys = loop_st_var_keys
    )
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Residualized ST models
    # Tests whether the ST component unexplained by conventional
    # structural controls still predicts outcomes.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    
    residual_control_vars_loop <- setdiff(control_vars_loop, residual_excluded_controls)
    
    # Re-residualize ST scores for this loop iteration using:
    #   - the target-specific base sample before main-model control filtering
    #   - the main-model controls for this target, excluding open issue/PR backlog controls
    #   - the same two-way FE structure used in these robustness models (repo_id + month)
    # This ensures FWL consistency per target variable and per subset
    # (including when LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP = TRUE).
    #
    # Wrapped in its own tryCatch so that residualization or model-fitting
    # failures (e.g. sparse clusters when target has many NAs, numerical issues
    # with raw-scale targets like prs_ttc_mean_hours) do not abort the outer
    # tryCatch and silently prevent results_summary from being populated.
    results_loop_resid <- NULL
    tryCatch({
      panel_complete_resid_loop <- panel_complete_loop_base
      
      for (var in residual_control_vars_loop) {
        if (var %in% names(panel_complete_resid_loop)) {
          panel_complete_resid_loop <- panel_complete_resid_loop %>%
            filter(!is.na(!!sym(var)))
        }
      }
      
      if (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP) {
        panel_complete_resid_loop <- panel_complete_resid_loop %>%
          filter(.data[[loop_status_var]] == LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET)
      }
      
      if (nrow(panel_complete_resid_loop) < 100) {
        stop("Insufficient complete cases for residualized model.")
      }
      
      panel_complete_resid_loop <- panel_complete_resid_loop %>%
        mutate(
          st1_resid = residualize_st_score(
            data = panel_complete_resid_loop,
            st_var = "st1_supplier_coverage",
            residual_controls = residual_control_vars_loop,
            use_log = use_log
          ),
          st2_resid = residualize_st_score(
            data = panel_complete_resid_loop,
            st_var = "st2_developer_coverage",
            residual_controls = residual_control_vars_loop,
            use_log = use_log
          ),
          st3_resid = residualize_st_score(
            data = panel_complete_resid_loop,
            st_var = "st3_edge_density",
            residual_controls = residual_control_vars_loop,
            use_log = use_log
          )
        )
      results_loop_resid <- build_st_models(
        data = panel_complete_resid_loop,
        target_var = target_var,
        control_vars = residual_control_vars_loop,
        vcov_type = "twoway",
        fixed_effects = "repo_id + month",
        # Residualized ST terms stay unlogged; controls are log-transformed.
        # This matches the residualized models in 03_sociotechnical_analysis.qmd.
        use_log = TRUE,
        standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS,
        include_group_interactions = FALSE,
        st_var_keys = c("ST1_resid", "ST2_resid", "ST3_resid")
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("    ! Residualized models failed for", target_var, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      cat("      (Main model results will still be saved to results_summary.)\n")
    })
    
    active_specs <- loop_specs %>% filter(key %in% names(results_loop$models))
    
    # Create models list for modelsummary
    models_list_loop <- lapply(active_specs$key, function(k) results_loop$models[[k]])
    names(models_list_loop) <- active_specs$table_label
    
    # Save modelsummary as PNG
    cat("\n  Saving modelsummary table...\n")
    output_file_table <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("table_", target_var_file_stub, ".html"))
    
    ms_table <- modelsummary(
      models_list_loop,
      stars = c('*' = 0.1, '**' = 0.05, '***' = 0.01),
      estimate  = "{estimate}{stars} ({std.error})",
      statistic = NULL,
      gof_map = c(get_table_gof_map(), "adj.r.squared"),
      fmt = 4,
      title = paste("Panel Regression:", target_var_text),
      notes = list(
        "Log-transformed variables. Robust SEs in parentheses.",
        "Fixed effects: repo_id + month",
        interaction_note,
        "* p<0.1, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01"
      ),
      output = output_file_table
    )
    
    cat("  âœ“ Saved:", output_file_table, "\n")
    
    # Extract ST effects for plots and summary
    effects_by_key <- lapply(active_specs$key, function(k) {
      spec <- active_specs %>% filter(key == k)
      model_k <- results_loop$models[[k]]
      effects_k <- extract_st_effects(
        model_k, spec$st_var[[1]], use_log = use_log,
        include_group_interactions = INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS,
        group_ref = GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE,
        standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS
      )
      base_k <- extract_reference_st_main(model_k, spec$st_var[[1]], use_log = use_log, standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS)
      list(
        key = k,
        plot_label = spec$plot_label[[1]],
        effects = effects_k,
        base = base_k,
        adjr2 = r2(model_k, type = "ar2"),
        n_obs = nrow(results_loop$data[[k]])
      )
    })
    names(effects_by_key) <- active_specs$key
    
    # Create coefficient plot
    st_coefs_loop <- bind_rows(
      lapply(effects_by_key, function(x) x$effects %>% mutate(Model = x$plot_label))
    )
    
    st_coefs_loop <- st_coefs_loop %>%
      mutate(
        CI_lower = Estimate - 1.96 * SE,
        CI_upper = Estimate + 1.96 * SE,
        Significant = ifelse(PValue < 0.1, "Yes", "No")
      )
    
    plot_loop <- ggplot(st_coefs_loop, aes(x = Model, y = Estimate, color = Significant, shape = Group)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), width = 0.2, size = 1,
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("No" = "gray60", "Yes" = "#e74c3c")) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Impact of ST Metrics on", target_var_text),
        subtitle = ifelse(
          INCLUDE_GROUP_INTERACTIONS,
          paste0("Fixed Effects Panel Regression with 95% CI by ", get_group_var_label(), " (ref = ", GROUP_INTERACTION_REFERENCE, ")"),
          "Fixed Effects Panel Regression with 95% CI (Log-transformed)"
        ),
        x = "Socio-Technical Metric",
        y = "Coefficient Estimate (Robust SE)",
        color = "Significant\n(p < 0.1)",
        shape = get_group_var_label()
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right"
      ) +
      coord_flip()
    
    # Save plot as PNG
    cat("  Saving coefficient plot...\n")
    output_file_plot <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("plot_", target_var_file_stub, ".png"))
    ggsave(output_file_plot, plot = plot_loop, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
    cat("  Saved:", output_file_plot, "\n")
    
    # Store results for summary table
    get_result_entry <- function(k) {
      if (!k %in% names(effects_by_key)) return(NA_character_)
      base <- effects_by_key[[k]]$base
      if (is.null(base) || is.na(base$Estimate)) return(NA_character_)
      format_st_result(
        base$Estimate,
        base$SE,
        base$PValue,
        effects_by_key[[k]]$adjr2
      )
    }
    
    get_result_entry_resid <- function(k) {
      tryCatch({
        if (!k %in% names(results_loop_resid$models)) return(NA_character_)
        model_k  <- results_loop_resid$models[[k]]
        st_var_k <- switch(k,
          ST1_resid = "st1_resid",
          ST2_resid = "st2_resid",
          ST3_resid = "st3_resid"
        )
        effects_k <- extract_st_effects(
          model_k,
          st_var = st_var_k,
          use_log = FALSE,
          include_group_interactions = FALSE,
          standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS
        )
        if (nrow(effects_k) == 0) return(NA_character_)
        format_st_result(
          effects_k$Estimate[1],
          effects_k$SE[1],
          effects_k$PValue[1],
          r2(model_k, type = "ar2")
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("    ! get_result_entry_resid(", k, ") failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
        NA_character_
      })
    }
    
    # Helper: extract a supplier count coefficient from one ST model
    get_ctrl_coef_result <- function(k, ctrl_var) {
      if (!k %in% names(results_loop$models)) return(NA_character_)
      model_k    <- results_loop$models[[k]]
      coef_label <- get_control_coef_name(ctrl_var, use_log = use_log, standardize = STANDARDIZE_VARS)
      info       <- extract_named_coef(model_k, coef_label)
      if (is.na(info$est)) return(NA_character_)
      adjr2_k <- tryCatch(unname(r2(model_k, type = "ar2")), error = function(e) NA_real_)
      format_st_result(info$est, info$se, info$pval, adjr2_k)
    }
    
    results_summary[[target_var]] <- list(
      target   = target_var,
      st1      = get_result_entry("ST1"),
      st2      = get_result_entry("ST2"),
      st3      = get_result_entry("ST3"),
      st1_resid = get_result_entry_resid("ST1_resid"),
      st2_resid = get_result_entry_resid("ST2_resid"),
      st3_resid = get_result_entry_resid("ST3_resid"),
      n_obs    = unname(unlist(lapply(effects_by_key, function(x) x$n_obs))),
      # Use a safe pull that returns NA_real_ when the ST key was not modelled
      # (e.g. ST3 is excluded when LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3 = FALSE). A bare pull() in
      # that case returns numeric(0), which breaks purrr::map_dfr's tibble
      # construction with a column-length mismatch error.
      st1_delta_wr2 = { v <- results_loop$model_comparison %>% filter(model_name == "ST1") %>% pull(delta_wr2); if (length(v) == 0L) NA_real_ else v[[1L]] },
      st2_delta_wr2 = { v <- results_loop$model_comparison %>% filter(model_name == "ST2") %>% pull(delta_wr2); if (length(v) == 0L) NA_real_ else v[[1L]] },
      st3_delta_wr2 = { v <- results_loop$model_comparison %>% filter(model_name == "ST3") %>% pull(delta_wr2); if (length(v) == 0L) NA_real_ else v[[1L]] },
      st1_tech = get_ctrl_coef_result("ST1", "technical_supplier_count"),
      st1_soc  = get_ctrl_coef_result("ST1", "social_supplier_count"),
      st2_tech = get_ctrl_coef_result("ST2", "technical_supplier_count"),
      st2_soc  = get_ctrl_coef_result("ST2", "social_supplier_count"),
      st3_tech = get_ctrl_coef_result("ST3", "technical_supplier_count"),
      st3_soc  = get_ctrl_coef_result("ST3", "social_supplier_count")
    )
    
    cat("  âœ“ Completed:", target_var, "\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  âœ— ERROR:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  })
}

cat("\n\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("BATCH PROCESSING COMPLETE\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("All results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
```

## Results Summary: All Target Variables

```{r}
# Create summary table of all results
if (length(results_summary) > 0) {
  
  concept_order <- c("Responsiveness", "Community", "Growth")
  target_vector <- sapply(results_summary, function(x) x$target)
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Target_Variable = target_vector,
    Concept = concept_map_targets[target_vector],
    ST1_Supplier_Coverage = sapply(results_summary, function(x) x$st1),
    ST2_Developer_Coverage = sapply(results_summary, function(x) x$st2),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) {
    summary_df$ST3_Edge_Density <- sapply(results_summary, function(x) x$st3)
  }
  
  summary_df$Target_Variable <- unname(target_display_labels[summary_df$Target_Variable])
  missing_labels <- is.na(summary_df$Target_Variable)
  summary_df$Target_Variable[missing_labels] <- gsub(
    "_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_vector[missing_labels])
  )
  target_order_labels <- unname(target_display_labels[target_variables_to_test])
  missing_target_order_labels <- is.na(target_order_labels)
  target_order_labels[missing_target_order_labels] <- gsub(
    "_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_variables_to_test[missing_target_order_labels])
  )
  summary_df$Concept <- factor(summary_df$Concept, levels = concept_order)
  summary_df$Target_Variable <- factor(
    summary_df$Target_Variable,
    levels = unique(target_order_labels)
  )
  summary_df <- summary_df[order(summary_df$Concept, summary_df$Target_Variable), ]
  
  concept_counts <- summary_df %>% count(Concept)

  summary_cols <- c("Target_Variable", "ST1_Supplier_Coverage", "ST2_Developer_Coverage")
  summary_col_names <- c("Target Variable", "ST1: Supplier Coverage", "ST2: Developer Coverage")
  if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) {
    summary_cols <- c(summary_cols, "ST3_Edge_Density")
    summary_col_names <- c(summary_col_names, "ST3: Edge Density")
  }
  
  html_table <- kable(summary_df %>% select(all_of(summary_cols)),
        col.names = summary_col_names,
        caption = "Panel Regression Results Summary: Log-Transformed Variables",
        align = c("l", rep("c", length(summary_cols) - 1)),
        format = "html",
        row.names = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 12) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Socio-Technical Metrics (Log-Transformed)" = length(summary_cols) - 1)) %>%
    kableExtra::footnote(general = summary_table_note(),
             general_title = "Note:",
             footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
  row_start <- 1
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(concept_counts))) {
    row_end <- row_start + concept_counts$n[i] - 1
    html_table <- html_table %>% pack_rows(as.character(concept_counts$Concept[i]), row_start, row_end)
    row_start <- row_end + 1
  }

  save_kable(html_table, file.path(output_dir, "summary_table_all_targets.html"))
  cat("Saved:", file.path(output_dir, "summary_table_all_targets.html"), "\n")

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    html_table
  } else {
    text_cols <- c("Concept", summary_cols)
    text_col_names <- c("Concept", summary_col_names)
    kable(summary_df %>% select(all_of(text_cols)),
          col.names = text_col_names,
          caption = "Panel Regression Results Summary: Log-Transformed Variables",
          align = c("l", "l", rep("c", length(summary_cols) - 1)),
          row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r condensed-summary-table}
# ── Short-form table: selected targets with remapped concept groupings ────────

  list(col = paste0("issues_tfr_mean_hours",      t_plus_n_suffix), label = "Issue TFR"),
  list(col = paste0("prs_tfr_mean_hours",          t_plus_n_suffix), label = "PR TFR"),

)

short_concept_map <- c(
  setNames(rep("Responsiveness",        4),
           sapply(short_form_targets[1:4],  `[[`, "col")),
  setNames(rep("Contributor Engagement", 3),
           sapply(short_form_targets[5:7],  `[[`, "col")),

           sapply(short_form_targets[8:10], `[[`, "col"))
)
short_concept_order <- c("Responsiveness", "Contributor Engagement", "Knowledge Production")

if (length(results_summary) > 0) {
  short_cols      <- sapply(short_form_targets, `[[`, "col")
  short_labels_v  <- sapply(short_form_targets, `[[`, "label")

  # Keep only rows that were actually modelled
  available_short <- short_cols[short_cols %in% names(results_summary)]
  if (length(available_short) == 0) {
    cat("No condensed-table targets found in results_summary — skipping.\n")
  } else {
    short_df <- data.frame(
      Target_Variable        = available_short,
      Concept                = short_concept_map[available_short],
      ST1_Supplier_Coverage  = sapply(results_summary[available_short], function(x) x$st1),
      ST2_Developer_Coverage = sapply(results_summary[available_short], function(x) x$st2),
      stringsAsFactors       = FALSE
    )
    if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) {
      short_df$ST3_Edge_Density <- sapply(results_summary[available_short], function(x) x$st3)
    }

    # Apply display labels in the specified order
    label_lookup <- setNames(short_labels_v, short_cols)
    short_df$Target_Variable <- unname(label_lookup[short_df$Target_Variable])

    short_df$Concept         <- factor(short_df$Concept,         levels = short_concept_order)
    short_df$Target_Variable <- factor(short_df$Target_Variable, levels = short_labels_v)
    short_df <- short_df[order(short_df$Concept, short_df$Target_Variable), ]

    concept_counts_short <- short_df %>% count(Concept)

    short_cols_sel  <- c("Target_Variable", "ST1_Supplier_Coverage", "ST2_Developer_Coverage")
    short_col_names <- c("Target Variable",  "ST1: Supplier Coverage", "ST2: Developer Coverage")
    if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) {
      short_cols_sel  <- c(short_cols_sel,  "ST3_Edge_Density")
      short_col_names <- c(short_col_names, "ST3: Edge Density")
    }
    n_st_cols <- length(short_col_names) - 1L  # number of ST metric columns

    short_html <- kable(
        short_df %>% select(all_of(short_cols_sel)),
        col.names   = short_col_names,
        caption     = "Panel Regression Results (Selected Variables)",
        align       = c("l", rep("c", n_st_cols)),
        format      = "html",
        row.names   = FALSE
      ) %>%
      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
        full_width        = FALSE,
        font_size         = 12
      ) %>%
      row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
      add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Socio-Technical Metrics (Log-Transformed)" = n_st_cols)) %>%
      kableExtra::footnote(
        general       = summary_table_note(),
        general_title = "Note:",
        footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
      )

    row_start <- 1
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(concept_counts_short))) {
      row_end   <- row_start + concept_counts_short$n[i] - 1
      short_html <- short_html %>%
        pack_rows(as.character(concept_counts_short$Concept[i]), row_start, row_end)
      row_start <- row_end + 1
    }

    short_html_path <- file.path(output_dir, "summary_table_condensed.html")
    save_kable(short_html, short_html_path)
    cat("Saved:", short_html_path, "\n")

    if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
      short_html
    } else {
      kable(
        short_df %>% select(Concept, all_of(short_cols_sel)),
        col.names   = c("Concept", short_col_names),
        caption     = "Panel Regression Results (Selected Variables)",
        align       = c("l", "l", rep("c", n_st_cols)),
        row.names   = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

extract_sig_marker <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || length(x) == 0) return("")
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "\\*\\*\\*") ~ "***",
    str_detect(x, "\\*\\*") ~ "**",
    str_detect(x, "\\*") ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

    st1_delta_wr2 = x$st1_delta_wr2,

    st3_delta_wr2 = x$st3_delta_wr2,

    st1_resid_sig = extract_sig_marker(x$st1_resid),
    st2_resid_sig = extract_sig_marker(x$st2_resid),
    st3_resid_sig = extract_sig_marker(x$st3_resid),

    st1_main = x$st1,
    st2_main = x$st2,
    st3_main = x$st3,

    st1_resid = x$st1_resid,
    st2_resid = x$st2_resid,
    st3_resid = x$st3_resid
  )
})
```

## Out-of-Sample R2: Repo-Held-Out TWFE

```{r}
# Repo-held-out OOS R2 for the same target/model setup used above.
# Prediction is on the held-out repo-demeaned scale and includes the
# training-estimated month fixed effects centered within the held-out repo.

OOS_BOOTSTRAP_REPS <- 1000
OOS_BOOTSTRAP_SEED <- 20260530

get_loop_controls_for_target <- function(target_var) {
  concept_for_target <- concept_map_targets[target_var]
  controls <- control_vars_base

  if (!is.na(concept_for_target) && concept_for_target == "Community") {
    controls <- setdiff(controls, community_control_vars)
  }

  if (!is.na(concept_for_target) && concept_for_target == "Growth") {
    controls <- setdiff(
      controls,
      c(
        "cumulative_commits_count_t",
        "cumulative_authors_t",
        "cumulative_prs_count_t",
        "cumulative_issues_count_t",
        "num_commits_t"
      )
    )
  }

  if (ADD_OPEN_ISSUES_CONTROL) {
    if (OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL %in% names(panel_data)) {
      controls <- unique(c(controls, OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL))
    }
    if (OPEN_PRS_CTRL %in% names(panel_data)) {
      controls <- unique(c(controls, OPEN_PRS_CTRL))
    }
  }

  controls
}

drop_entity_invariant_controls <- function(data, control_vars, entity_var = "repo_id") {
  if (!entity_var %in% names(data)) return(control_vars)

  invariant_controls <- c()

  for (ctrl in control_vars) {
    if (ctrl %in% names(data)) {
      variation_check <- data %>%
        group_by(.data[[entity_var]]) %>%
        summarise(n_vals = n_distinct(.data[[ctrl]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

      if (all(variation_check$n_vals <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        invariant_controls <- c(invariant_controls, ctrl)
      }
    }
  }

  setdiff(control_vars, invariant_controls)
}

prepare_oos_model_df <- function(data,
                                 target_var,
                                 st_var,
                                 control_vars,
                                 entity_var = "repo_id",
                                 time_var = "month") {
  required_vars <- unique(c(target_var, st_var, control_vars, entity_var, time_var, "target_month"))
  required_vars <- required_vars[required_vars %in% names(data)]

  model_df <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[target_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[st_var]])
    )

  if ("target_month" %in% names(model_df)) {
    model_df <- model_df %>%
      filter(target_month <= as.Date("2026-01-01"))
  }

  if (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP) {
    model_df <- model_df %>%
      filter(.data[[loop_status_var]] == LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET)
  }

  model_df %>%
    select(all_of(required_vars)) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(log1p(.data[[target_var]])),
      if_all(all_of(c(st_var, control_vars)), ~ is.finite(log1p(.x)))
    )
}

make_log_rhs <- function(vars, fixed_effects = "repo_id + month") {
  vars <- vars[nzchar(vars)]
  if (length(vars) == 0L) {
    paste0("1 | ", fixed_effects)
  } else {
    paste0(
      paste(paste0("log1p(", vars, ")"), collapse = " + "),
      " | ",
      fixed_effects
    )
  }
}

oos_repo_holdout_twfe_components <- function(data,
                                             target_var,
                                             rhs_vars,
                                             entity_var = "repo_id",
                                             time_var = "month") {
  repos <- sort(unique(data[[entity_var]]))
  rhs_vars <- rhs_vars[rhs_vars %in% names(data)]

  if (length(repos) < 3L) return(tibble())

  full_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("log1p(", target_var, ") ~ ", make_log_rhs(rhs_vars))
  )

  repo_components <- vector("list", length(repos))

  for (repo_idx in seq_along(repos)) {
    repo <- repos[[repo_idx]]
    train_data <- data[data[[entity_var]] != repo, , drop = FALSE]
    test_data <- data[data[[entity_var]] == repo, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(test_data) < 2L) next

    model <- tryCatch(
      feols(full_formula, data = train_data, vcov = "iid"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(model)) next

    beta_names <- paste0("log1p(", rhs_vars, ")")
    beta <- tryCatch(coef(model)[beta_names], error = function(e) NULL)
    if (length(rhs_vars) > 0L && (is.null(beta) || anyNA(beta))) next

    y_raw <- log1p(test_data[[target_var]])

    if (length(rhs_vars) > 0L) {
      X_raw <- vapply(
        setNames(rhs_vars, beta_names),
        function(v) log1p(test_data[[v]]),
        numeric(nrow(test_data))
      )
      if (!is.matrix(X_raw)) {
        X_raw <- matrix(X_raw, nrow = nrow(test_data), dimnames = list(NULL, beta_names))
      }
      valid <- is.finite(y_raw) & rowSums(!is.finite(X_raw)) == 0L
    } else {
      X_raw <- matrix(nrow = nrow(test_data), ncol = 0L)
      valid <- is.finite(y_raw)
    }

    if (sum(valid) < 2L) next

    y_test <- y_raw[valid]
    X_test <- X_raw[valid, , drop = FALSE]
    time_test <- test_data[[time_var]][valid]

    time_fe <- tryCatch(fixef(model)[[time_var]], error = function(e) NULL)
    time_hat <- rep(0, length(y_test))

    if (!is.null(time_fe)) {
      time_hat <- unname(time_fe[as.character(time_test)])
      valid_time <- is.finite(time_hat)

      if (sum(valid_time) < 2L) next

      y_test <- y_test[valid_time]
      X_test <- X_test[valid_time, , drop = FALSE]
      time_hat <- time_hat[valid_time]
    }

    y_dm <- y_test - mean(y_test)
    time_dm <- time_hat - mean(time_hat)

    if (length(rhs_vars) > 0L) {
      X_dm <- sweep(X_test, 2L, colMeans(X_test), "-")
      ypred_dm <- as.vector(X_dm %*% beta) + time_dm
    } else {
      ypred_dm <- time_dm
    }

    e <- y_dm - ypred_dm

    repo_components[[repo_idx]] <- tibble(
      repo = repo,
      e2_sum = sum(e^2),
      ydm2_sum = sum(y_dm^2),
      n_holdout = length(e)
    )
  }

  bind_rows(repo_components)
}

oos_r2_from_components <- function(components) {
  if (nrow(components) == 0L || sum(components$ydm2_sum, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  1 - sum(components$e2_sum, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(components$ydm2_sum, na.rm = TRUE)
}

oos_r2_repo_holdout_twfe <- function(data,
                                     target_var,
                                     rhs_vars,
                                     entity_var = "repo_id",
                                     time_var = "month") {
  components <- oos_repo_holdout_twfe_components(
    data = data,
    target_var = target_var,
    rhs_vars = rhs_vars,
    entity_var = entity_var,
    time_var = time_var
  )

  oos_r2_from_components(components)
}

bootstrap_oos_delta_r2 <- function(null_components,
                                   st_components,
                                   n_boot = OOS_BOOTSTRAP_REPS) {
  empty_bootstrap_result <- tibble(
    oos_r2_null = NA_real_,
    oos_r2_st = NA_real_,
    delta_oos_r2 = NA_real_,
    delta_oos_r2_mean = NA_real_,
    delta_oos_r2_ci_low = NA_real_,
    delta_oos_r2_ci_high = NA_real_
  )

  if (nrow(null_components) == 0L || nrow(st_components) == 0L) {
    return(empty_bootstrap_result)
  }

  paired_components <- null_components %>%
    select(repo, null_e2_sum = e2_sum, null_ydm2_sum = ydm2_sum) %>%
    inner_join(
      st_components %>%
        select(repo, st_e2_sum = e2_sum, st_ydm2_sum = ydm2_sum),
      by = "repo"
    )

  if (nrow(paired_components) < 3L) {
    return(empty_bootstrap_result)
  }

  if (sum(paired_components$null_ydm2_sum) == 0 ||
      sum(paired_components$st_ydm2_sum) == 0) {
    return(empty_bootstrap_result)
  }

  observed_null <- 1 - sum(paired_components$null_e2_sum) / sum(paired_components$null_ydm2_sum)
  observed_st <- 1 - sum(paired_components$st_e2_sum) / sum(paired_components$st_ydm2_sum)
  observed_delta <- observed_st - observed_null

  boot_delta <- replicate(n_boot, {
    boot_idx <- sample.int(nrow(paired_components), replace = TRUE)
    boot_df <- paired_components[boot_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    if (sum(boot_df$null_ydm2_sum) == 0 || sum(boot_df$st_ydm2_sum) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    boot_null <- 1 - sum(boot_df$null_e2_sum) / sum(boot_df$null_ydm2_sum)
    boot_st <- 1 - sum(boot_df$st_e2_sum) / sum(boot_df$st_ydm2_sum)

    boot_st - boot_null
  })

  tibble(
    oos_r2_null = observed_null,
    oos_r2_st = observed_st,
    delta_oos_r2 = observed_delta,
    delta_oos_r2_mean = mean(boot_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_oos_r2_ci_low = unname(quantile(boot_delta, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    delta_oos_r2_ci_high = unname(quantile(boot_delta, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

compute_oos_r2_for_target_model <- function(target_var, spec) {
  model_key <- as.character(spec$key[[1]])
  st_var <- as.character(spec$st_var[[1]])

  if (!(target_var %in% names(panel_data)) || !(st_var %in% names(panel_data))) {
    return(tibble(
      outcome = target_var,
      model = model_key,
      n_obs = NA_integer_,
      n_repo = NA_integer_,
      n_month = NA_integer_,
      oos_r2_null = NA_real_,
      oos_r2_st = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2 = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2_mean = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2_ci_low = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2_ci_high = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  controls <- get_loop_controls_for_target(target_var)
  controls <- drop_entity_invariant_controls(panel_data, controls)
  controls <- controls[controls %in% names(panel_data)]

  model_df <- prepare_oos_model_df(
    data = panel_data,
    target_var = target_var,
    st_var = st_var,
    control_vars = controls
  )

  if (nrow(model_df) < 100L) {
    return(tibble(
      outcome = target_var,
      model = model_key,
      n_obs = nrow(model_df),
      n_repo = n_distinct(model_df$repo_id),
      n_month = n_distinct(model_df$month),
      oos_r2_null = NA_real_,
      oos_r2_st = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2 = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2_mean = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2_ci_low = NA_real_,
      delta_oos_r2_ci_high = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  null_components <- oos_repo_holdout_twfe_components(
    data = model_df,
    target_var = target_var,
    rhs_vars = controls
  )

  st_components <- oos_repo_holdout_twfe_components(
    data = model_df,
    target_var = target_var,
    rhs_vars = c(st_var, controls)
  )

  oos_boot <- bootstrap_oos_delta_r2(
    null_components = null_components,
    st_components = st_components
  )

  tibble(
    outcome = target_var,
    model = model_key,
    n_obs = nrow(model_df),
    n_repo = n_distinct(model_df$repo_id),
    n_month = n_distinct(model_df$month)
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(oos_boot)
}

message("Computing repo-held-out OOS R2 for socio-technical models ...")

# Condensed publication-style table matching the within-R2 summary structure.
format_oos_delta_ci <- function(mean_delta, ci_low, ci_high, digits = 4) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(mean_delta) | is.na(ci_low) | is.na(ci_high),
    "",
    sprintf(
      paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f)"),
      mean_delta,
      ci_low,
      ci_high
    )
  )
}

short_oos_cols <- sapply(short_form_targets, `[[`, "col")
short_oos_labels <- sapply(short_form_targets, `[[`, "label")

if (length(available_short_oos) == 0) {
  cat("No condensed-table targets found in st_oos_r2_summary - skipping condensed OOS R2 table.\n")
} else {
  st_oos_r2_condensed <- st_oos_r2_summary %>%
    filter(outcome %in% available_short_oos) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_oos_r2_ci = format_oos_delta_ci(
        delta_oos_r2_mean,
        delta_oos_r2_ci_low,
        delta_oos_r2_ci_high
      )
    ) %>%
    select(outcome, model, delta_oos_r2_ci) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = model,
      values_from = delta_oos_r2_ci,
      names_glue = "{model}_delta_oos_r2_ci"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Concept = short_concept_map[outcome],
      Variable = unname(setNames(short_oos_labels, short_oos_cols)[outcome]),
      Concept = factor(Concept, levels = short_concept_order),
      Variable = factor(Variable, levels = short_oos_labels)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Concept, Variable) %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = as.character(Variable)
    )

  st_oos_r2_condensed_cols <- c("Variable", "ST1_delta_oos_r2_ci", "ST2_delta_oos_r2_ci")
  st_oos_r2_condensed_names <- c(
    "Variable",
    "ST1 Mean Delta OOS R2 (95% CI)",
    "ST2 Mean Delta OOS R2 (95% CI)"
  )

  if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3 && "ST3_delta_oos_r2_ci" %in% names(st_oos_r2_condensed)) {
    st_oos_r2_condensed_cols <- c(st_oos_r2_condensed_cols, "ST3_delta_oos_r2_ci")
    st_oos_r2_condensed_names <- c(
      st_oos_r2_condensed_names,
      "ST3 Mean Delta OOS R2 (95% CI)"
    )
  }

  st_oos_r2_condensed_display <- st_oos_r2_condensed %>%
    select(Concept, all_of(st_oos_r2_condensed_cols))

  print(st_oos_r2_condensed_display)

  write_csv(
    st_oos_r2_condensed_display,
    file.path(output_dir, "st_oos_r2_repo_holdout_condensed.csv")
  )

  concept_counts_oos <- st_oos_r2_condensed_display %>% count(Concept)

  st_oos_r2_condensed_html <- kable(
      st_oos_r2_condensed_display %>% select(-Concept),
      col.names = st_oos_r2_condensed_names,
      caption = "Socio-technical Scores Repo-Held-Out OOS R2",
      align = c("l", rep("c", length(st_oos_r2_condensed_cols) - 1L)),
      format = "html",
      row.names = FALSE
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      font_size = 12
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0")

  row_start <- 1
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(concept_counts_oos))) {
    row_end <- row_start + concept_counts_oos$n[i] - 1
    st_oos_r2_condensed_html <- st_oos_r2_condensed_html %>%
      pack_rows(as.character(concept_counts_oos$Concept[i]), row_start, row_end)
    row_start <- row_end + 1
  }

  st_oos_r2_condensed_html_path <- file.path(output_dir, "st_oos_r2_repo_holdout_condensed.html")
  save_kable(st_oos_r2_condensed_html, st_oos_r2_condensed_html_path)
  cat("Saved:", st_oos_r2_condensed_html_path, "\n")

  st_oos_r2_condensed_docx <- st_oos_r2_condensed_display %>%
    mutate(Concept = as.character(Concept)) %>%
    group_by(Concept) %>%
    group_modify(~ bind_rows(
      tibble(
        Variable = .y$Concept,
        !!!setNames(rep(list(""), length(st_oos_r2_condensed_cols) - 1L),
                    st_oos_r2_condensed_cols[-1])
      ),
      .x %>% select(all_of(st_oos_r2_condensed_cols))
    )) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(all_of(st_oos_r2_condensed_cols))

  st_oos_r2_header_labels <- c(
    Variable = "Variable",
    ST1_delta_oos_r2_ci = "ST1 Mean Delta OOS R2 (95% CI)",
    ST2_delta_oos_r2_ci = "ST2 Mean Delta OOS R2 (95% CI)",
    ST3_delta_oos_r2_ci = "ST3 Mean Delta OOS R2 (95% CI)"
  )
  st_oos_r2_header_labels <- st_oos_r2_header_labels[
    names(st_oos_r2_header_labels) %in% names(st_oos_r2_condensed_docx)
  ]

  st_oos_r2_condensed_ft <- flextable::flextable(st_oos_r2_condensed_docx)
  st_oos_r2_condensed_ft <- do.call(
    flextable::set_header_labels,
    c(list(st_oos_r2_condensed_ft), as.list(st_oos_r2_header_labels))
  ) %>%
    flextable::bold(i = which(st_oos_r2_condensed_docx$Variable %in% short_concept_order), bold = TRUE) %>%
    flextable::autofit()

  flextable::save_as_docx(
    st_oos_r2_condensed_ft,
    path = file.path(output_dir, "st_oos_r2_repo_holdout_condensed.docx")
  )

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    st_oos_r2_condensed_html
  } else {
    st_oos_r2_condensed_ft
  }
}
```

## Condensed ST Results with Inline Supplier Count Estimates

The following table builds on the condensed ST summary above (same 4 responsiveness, 3 contributor engagement, and 3 knowledge-production targets) but appends the `technical_supplier_count` (TSC) and `social_supplier_count` (SSC) estimates — each with their own significance stars — directly inside the brackets after the standard error. Cell format: `ST Estimate[ST stars] (SE, TSC: estimate[stars], SSC: estimate[stars])`.

```{r condensed-combined-st-supplier-table}
# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Extract numeric estimate string and trailing significance stars from a
# format_st_result() string like "0.0430 (0.0120)**" or "-0.0430 (0.0120, Adj. R2: 0.234)***"
parse_est_stars <- function(s) {
  if (is.null(s) || length(s) == 0 || is.na(s) || s == "NA") {
    return(list(est = NA_character_, stars = ""))
  }
  est_m   <- regmatches(s, regexpr("^-?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+", s))
  est     <- if (length(est_m) == 0) NA_character_ else est_m
  stars_m <- regmatches(s, regexpr("[*]+$", s))
  stars   <- if (length(stars_m) == 0) "" else stars_m
  list(est = est, stars = stars)
}

# Build one combined cell string from three format_st_result() strings
build_combined_cell <- function(st_str, tech_str, soc_str) {
  if (is.null(st_str) || length(st_str) == 0 || is.na(st_str) || st_str == "NA") return("\u2014")

  # Parse main ST: extract estimate, SE, and trailing stars
  m <- regmatches(st_str, regexec("^(-?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+) \\((-?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)", st_str))[[1]]
  if (length(m) < 3) return(st_str)
  coef_s     <- m[2]
  se_s       <- m[3]
  star_pos   <- regexpr("[*]+$", st_str)
  main_stars <- if (star_pos == -1) "" else regmatches(st_str, star_pos)

  tsc <- parse_est_stars(tech_str)
  soc <- parse_est_stars(soc_str)

  tsc_part <- if (!is.na(tsc$est)) paste0("TSC: ", tsc$est, tsc$stars) else "TSC: \u2014"
  soc_part <- if (!is.na(soc$est)) paste0("SSC: ", soc$est, soc$stars) else "SSC: \u2014"

  paste0(coef_s, main_stars, " (", se_s, ", ", tsc_part, ", ", soc_part, ")")
}

if (length(results_summary) > 0) {

  available_short_comb <- short_cols[short_cols %in% names(results_summary)]

  if (length(available_short_comb) == 0) {
    cat("No condensed-table targets found in results_summary — skipping.\n")
  } else {
    comb_df <- data.frame(
      Target_Variable = available_short_comb,
      Concept         = short_concept_map[available_short_comb],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    comb_df$ST1_Combined <- mapply(
      build_combined_cell,
```

## Supplier Count Effects (No ST Scores)

The following table re-runs every target-variable model **without any ST scores** (ST1 / ST2 / ST3) and reports only the estimates and significance of `technical_supplier_count` and `social_supplier_count`. All other modelling choices (fixed effects, vcov, log-transformation, control variables, CNCF status filter) are identical to the main loop above.

```{r supplier-count-models}
# ── Controls: same as main loop, but with ST scores removed ──────────────────
supplier_control_vars_base <- control_vars_base
# (technical_supplier_count and social_supplier_count are already in
#  control_vars_base; they become the focal predictors here)

supplier_results_summary <- list()

for (target_var in target_variables_to_test) {

  target_var_text <- unname(target_display_labels[target_var])
  if (is.na(target_var_text) || target_var_text == "") {
    target_var_text <- gsub("_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_var))
  }

  cat("\nProcessing:", target_var_text, "\n")

  # ── Skip if target column is missing ────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!target_var %in% names(panel_data)) {
    cat("  ✗ Column not found - SKIPPING\n")
    next
  }

  # ── Concept-specific control adjustment (mirror main loop) ──────────────────
  concept_for_target <- concept_map_targets[target_var]
  supplier_control_vars_loop <- supplier_control_vars_base
  if (!is.na(concept_for_target) && concept_for_target == "Community") {
    supplier_control_vars_loop <- setdiff(supplier_control_vars_loop, community_control_vars)
  }
  # Add open issues/PRs count at t as a control for all models
  if (ADD_OPEN_ISSUES_CONTROL) {
    if (OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL %in% names(panel_data)) {
      supplier_control_vars_loop <- unique(c(supplier_control_vars_loop, OPEN_ISSUES_CTRL))
    }
    if (OPEN_PRS_CTRL %in% names(panel_data)) {
      supplier_control_vars_loop <- unique(c(supplier_control_vars_loop, OPEN_PRS_CTRL))
    }
  }

  # ── Build complete cases for this target ────────────────────────────────────
  needed_vars <- c(
    target_var,
    supplier_control_vars_loop,
    "repo_id", "month", "target_month",
    if (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP) loop_status_var else NULL
  )
  available_vars <- intersect(needed_vars, names(panel_data))
  panel_complete_sup <- panel_data %>%
    select(all_of(available_vars)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(target_var))) %>%
    filter(target_month <= as.Date("2026-01-01"))

  for (var in supplier_control_vars_loop) {
    if (var %in% names(panel_complete_sup)) {
      panel_complete_sup <- panel_complete_sup %>%
        filter(!is.na(!!sym(var)))
    }
  }

  if (LOOP_FILTER_BY_GROUP) {
    panel_complete_sup <- panel_complete_sup %>%
      filter(.data[[loop_status_var]] == LOOP_GROUP_SUBSET)
  }

  cat("  Complete cases:", nrow(panel_complete_sup), "\n")

  if (nrow(panel_complete_sup) < 100) {
    cat("  ✗ Insufficient data - SKIPPING\n")
    next
  }

  # ── Build formula (respects use_log and STANDARDIZE_VARS) ──────────────────
  other_controls <- setdiff(
    supplier_control_vars_loop,
    c("technical_supplier_count", "social_supplier_count")
  )
  if (STANDARDIZE_VARS) {
    all_sup_vars <- unique(c(target_var, "technical_supplier_count",
                             "social_supplier_count", other_controls))
    sup_df_std <- panel_complete_sup
    for (v in all_sup_vars) {
      if (v %in% names(sup_df_std) && is.numeric(sup_df_std[[v]])) {
        raw_vals <- if (use_log) log1p(sup_df_std[[v]]) else sup_df_std[[v]]
        sup_df_std[[paste0("zs_", v)]] <- as.numeric(scale(raw_vals))
      }
    }
    dep_var_formula  <- paste0("zs_", target_var)
    focal_predictors <- c("zs_technical_supplier_count", "zs_social_supplier_count")
    other_rhs <- if (length(other_controls) > 0) {
      paste(paste0("zs_", other_controls), collapse = " + ")
    } else {
      ""
    }
    data_for_model <- sup_df_std
    tech_coef_name <- "zs_technical_supplier_count"
    soc_coef_name  <- "zs_social_supplier_count"
  } else if (use_log) {
    dep_var_formula  <- paste0("log1p(", target_var, ")")
    focal_predictors <- c("log1p(technical_supplier_count)", "log1p(social_supplier_count)")
    other_rhs <- if (length(other_controls) > 0) {
      paste(paste0("log1p(", other_controls, ")"), collapse = " + ")
    } else {
      ""
    }
    data_for_model <- panel_complete_sup
    tech_coef_name <- "log1p(technical_supplier_count)"
    soc_coef_name  <- "log1p(social_supplier_count)"
  } else {
    dep_var_formula  <- target_var
    focal_predictors <- c("technical_supplier_count", "social_supplier_count")
    other_rhs <- if (length(other_controls) > 0) {
      paste(other_controls, collapse = " + ")
    } else {
      ""
    }
    data_for_model <- panel_complete_sup
    tech_coef_name <- "technical_supplier_count"
    soc_coef_name  <- "social_supplier_count"
  }
  rhs <- paste(
    c(focal_predictors, if (nzchar(other_rhs)) other_rhs else NULL),
    collapse = " + "
  )
  fe_str  <- "repo_id + month"
  formula_sup <- as.formula(paste(dep_var_formula, "~", rhs, "|", fe_str))

  tryCatch({
    model_sup <- fixest::feols(
      formula_sup,
      data  = data_for_model,
      vcov  = "twoway"
    )

    coefs  <- coef(model_sup)
    vcovM  <- vcov(model_sup)
    ses    <- sqrt(diag(vcovM))

    # ── Helper: pull est/SE/p for one predictor name ─────────────────────────
    extract_coef_info <- function(pred_name) {
      if (!pred_name %in% names(coefs)) {
        return(list(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_))
      }
      est  <- coefs[pred_name]
      se   <- ses[pred_name]
      tval <- est / se
      df   <- model_sup$nobs - length(coefs)
      pval <- 2 * pt(abs(tval), df = max(df, 1), lower.tail = FALSE)
      list(est = est, se = se, pval = pval)
    }

    tech <- extract_coef_info(tech_coef_name)
    soc  <- extract_coef_info(soc_coef_name)

    # Adj R² for reference (optional, controlled by INCLUDE_ADJ_R2_IN_TABLES)
    adjr2_val <- tryCatch(
      unname(r2(model_sup, type = "ar2")),
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )

    supplier_results_summary[[target_var]] <- list(
      target       = target_var,
      tech_result  = format_st_result(tech$est, tech$se, tech$pval, adjr2_val),
      soc_result   = format_st_result(soc$est,  soc$se,  soc$pval,  adjr2_val),
      n_obs        = nrow(panel_complete_sup)
    )

    cat("  ✔ Completed:", target_var, "\n")

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ✗ ERROR:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  })
}

cat("\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("SUPPLIER COUNT MODELS COMPLETE\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
```

```{r supplier-count-summary-table}
if (length(supplier_results_summary) > 0) {

  concept_order <- c("Responsiveness", "Community", "Growth")

  target_vector_sup <- sapply(supplier_results_summary, function(x) x$target)

  supplier_summary_df <- data.frame(
    Target_Variable          = target_vector_sup,
    Concept                  = concept_map_targets[target_vector_sup],
    Technical_Supplier_Count = sapply(supplier_results_summary, function(x) x$tech_result),
    Social_Supplier_Count    = sapply(supplier_results_summary, function(x) x$soc_result),
    N_Obs                    = sapply(supplier_results_summary, function(x) x$n_obs),
    stringsAsFactors         = FALSE
  )

  # ── Apply display labels & ordering (mirrors main summary table) ─────────────
  supplier_summary_df$Target_Variable <- unname(target_display_labels[supplier_summary_df$Target_Variable])
  missing_labels_sup <- is.na(supplier_summary_df$Target_Variable)
  supplier_summary_df$Target_Variable[missing_labels_sup] <- gsub(
    "_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_vector_sup[missing_labels_sup])
  )

  target_order_labels_sup <- unname(target_display_labels[target_variables_to_test])
  missing_order_sup <- is.na(target_order_labels_sup)
  target_order_labels_sup[missing_order_sup] <- gsub(
    "_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_variables_to_test[missing_order_sup])
  )

  supplier_summary_df$Concept         <- factor(supplier_summary_df$Concept, levels = concept_order)
  supplier_summary_df$Target_Variable <- factor(
    supplier_summary_df$Target_Variable,
    levels = unique(target_order_labels_sup)
  )
  supplier_summary_df <- supplier_summary_df[
    order(supplier_summary_df$Concept, supplier_summary_df$Target_Variable), ]

  concept_counts_sup <- supplier_summary_df %>% count(Concept)

  # ── Build kable ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  supplier_note <- paste0(
    "Models exclude all ST scores (ST1/ST2/ST3). ",
    "Controls: log1p(cumulative_stars_t), log1p(cumulative_forks_t), log1p(age_in_months_t). ",
    "Fixed effects: repo_id + month. Cluster-robust (two-way) SEs. ",
    "Cell format: Estimate (SE)",
    if (INCLUDE_ADJ_R2_IN_TABLES) ", Adj. R²" else "",
    ". * p<0.1, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01."
  )

  html_table_sup <- kable(
    supplier_summary_df %>%
      select(Target_Variable, Technical_Supplier_Count, Social_Supplier_Count),
    col.names  = c("Target Variable",
                   "Technical Supplier Count",
                   "Social Supplier Count"),
    caption    = "Supplier Count Effects: Models Without ST Scores (Log-Transformed)",
    align      = c("l", "c", "c"),
    format     = "html",
    row.names  = FALSE
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width        = FALSE,
      font_size         = 12
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Control Variables (Focal Predictors)" = 2)) %>%
    kableExtra::footnote(
      general       = supplier_note,
      general_title = "Note:",
      footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
    )

  # Add concept group rows
  row_start_sup <- 1
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(concept_counts_sup))) {
    row_end_sup <- row_start_sup + concept_counts_sup$n[i] - 1
    html_table_sup <- html_table_sup %>%
      pack_rows(as.character(concept_counts_sup$Concept[i]), row_start_sup, row_end_sup)
    row_start_sup <- row_end_sup + 1
  }

  save_kable(html_table_sup, file.path(output_dir, "summary_table_supplier_counts.html"))
  cat("Saved:", file.path(output_dir, "summary_table_supplier_counts.html"), "\n")

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    html_table_sup
  } else {
    kable(
      supplier_summary_df %>%
        select(Concept, Target_Variable, Technical_Supplier_Count, Social_Supplier_Count),
      col.names  = c("Concept", "Target Variable",
                     "Technical Supplier Count", "Social Supplier Count"),
      caption    = "Supplier Count Effects: Models Without ST Scores",
      align      = c("l", "l", "c", "c"),
      row.names  = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

## Supplier Count Effects (With ST Scores)

The following table extracts the estimates and significance of `technical_supplier_count` and `social_supplier_count` from the **same models that include the ST scores** (ST1 / ST2 / ST3). This lets you compare how the supplier count control variables behave alongside the ST measures. All modelling choices (fixed effects, vcov, log-transformation, CNCF status filter) are identical to the main loop above.

```{r st-supplier-count-summary-table}
if (length(results_summary) > 0) {

  concept_order <- c("Responsiveness", "Community", "Growth")

  target_vector_st_sup <- sapply(results_summary, function(x) x$target)

  # ── Build data frame ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  st_sup_df <- data.frame(
    Target_Variable = target_vector_st_sup,
    Concept         = concept_map_targets[target_vector_st_sup],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  pull_field <- function(field) {
    sapply(results_summary, function(x) {
      v <- x[[field]]
      if (is.null(v)) NA_character_ else v
    })
  }

  st_sup_df$ST1_Tech <- pull_field("st1_tech")
  st_sup_df$ST1_Soc  <- pull_field("st1_soc")
  st_sup_df$ST2_Tech <- pull_field("st2_tech")
  st_sup_df$ST2_Soc  <- pull_field("st2_soc")
  if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) {
    st_sup_df$ST3_Tech <- pull_field("st3_tech")
    st_sup_df$ST3_Soc  <- pull_field("st3_soc")
  }

  # ── Apply display labels & ordering (mirrors main summary table) ─────────────
  st_sup_df$Target_Variable <- unname(target_display_labels[st_sup_df$Target_Variable])
  missing_st_sup <- is.na(st_sup_df$Target_Variable)
  st_sup_df$Target_Variable[missing_st_sup] <- gsub(
    "_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_vector_st_sup[missing_st_sup])
  )

  target_order_st_sup <- unname(target_display_labels[target_variables_to_test])
  missing_order_st_sup <- is.na(target_order_st_sup)
  target_order_st_sup[missing_order_st_sup] <- gsub(
    "_", " ", gsub(t_plus_n_suffix, "", target_variables_to_test[missing_order_st_sup])
  )

  st_sup_df$Concept         <- factor(st_sup_df$Concept, levels = concept_order)
  st_sup_df$Target_Variable <- factor(
    st_sup_df$Target_Variable, levels = unique(target_order_st_sup)
  )
  st_sup_df <- st_sup_df[order(st_sup_df$Concept, st_sup_df$Target_Variable), ]

  concept_counts_st_sup <- st_sup_df %>% count(Concept)

  # ── Column specs (dynamic based on whether ST3 is included) ─────────────────
  if (LOOP_INCLUDE_ST3) {
    data_cols     <- c("Target_Variable",
                       "ST1_Tech", "ST1_Soc",
                       "ST2_Tech", "ST2_Soc",
                       "ST3_Tech", "ST3_Soc")
    col_names_out <- c("Target Variable",
                       "Tech. Supplier", "Social Supplier",
                       "Tech. Supplier", "Social Supplier",
                       "Tech. Supplier", "Social Supplier")
    header_above  <- c(" " = 1, "ST1 Model" = 2, "ST2 Model" = 2, "ST3 Model" = 2)
  } else {
    data_cols     <- c("Target_Variable",
                       "ST1_Tech", "ST1_Soc",
                       "ST2_Tech", "ST2_Soc")
    col_names_out <- c("Target Variable",
                       "Tech. Supplier", "Social Supplier",
                       "Tech. Supplier", "Social Supplier")
    header_above  <- c(" " = 1, "ST1 Model" = 2, "ST2 Model" = 2)
  }

  st_sup_note <- paste0(
    "Supplier count coefficients extracted from models that include ST scores (ST1/ST2/ST3 respectively). ",
    "All variables log-transformed",
    if (STANDARDIZE_VARS) " and z-score standardised (beta coefficients)" else "",
    ". Robust two-way cluster SEs. Fixed effects: repo_id + month. ",
    "Cell format: Estimate (SE)",
    if (INCLUDE_ADJ_R2_IN_TABLES) ", Adj. R\u00b2" else "",
    ". * p<0.1, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01."
  )

  html_table_st_sup <- kable(
    st_sup_df %>% select(all_of(data_cols)),
    col.names  = col_names_out,
    caption    = "Supplier Count Effects in Models WITH ST Scores (Log-Transformed)",
    align      = c("l", rep("c", length(data_cols) - 1)),
    format     = "html",
    row.names  = FALSE
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width        = FALSE,
      font_size         = 12
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
    add_header_above(header_above) %>%
    kableExtra::footnote(
      general       = st_sup_note,
      general_title = "Note:",
      footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
    )

  row_start_st_sup <- 1
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(concept_counts_st_sup))) {
    row_end_st_sup <- row_start_st_sup + concept_counts_st_sup$n[i] - 1
    html_table_st_sup <- html_table_st_sup %>%
      pack_rows(as.character(concept_counts_st_sup$Concept[i]), row_start_st_sup, row_end_st_sup)
    row_start_st_sup <- row_end_st_sup + 1
  }

  save_kable(html_table_st_sup,
             file.path(output_dir, "summary_table_supplier_counts_with_st.html"))
  cat("Saved:", file.path(output_dir, "summary_table_supplier_counts_with_st.html"), "\n")

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    html_table_st_sup
  } else {
    kable(
      st_sup_df %>% select(Concept, all_of(data_cols)),
      col.names  = c("Concept", col_names_out),
      caption    = "Supplier Count Effects in Models WITH ST Scores",
      align      = c("l", "l", rep("c", length(data_cols) - 1)),
      row.names  = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```
